data.title: Performance Marketer, Acquisition
data.description:
Who We Are

Zefir is building an AI autopilot for home sales in Europe, starting in France. Our agent runs each sale from listing to closing. It coordinates buyers, sellers, and local brokers, manages listings across property portals, and handles the paperwork. We help homeowners sell for the best price on a timeline that works for them.

We’ve raised €60 million from Sequoia Capital and other leading investors. Our goal is to help millions of Europeans take the next step in their lives, whether that means moving to a new city for work or making room for a growing family.

About the Team

Our growth starts with reaching the right sellers and earning their trust. You'll join Growth & Marketing alongside Creative, CRM and Brand, and work in an acquisition squad with teammates from Product, Tech and Operations. A performance marketing agency and freelancers handle part of the day-to-day execution. You'll report to our Growth & Marketing Lead.

The Role

As our Performance Marketer, Acquisition, you'll own paid acquisition and manage more than €15M in annual spend across Meta, Google, TikTok, ChatGPT and new channels. Your job is to turn that spend into seller leads and booked sales meetings.

Our goal is to double seller leads year over year and cut the cost per booked sales meeting by 10%. You'll need to maintain lead quality in a crowded market: Meta and TikTok are starting to compete for the same audiences, and so are Google and ChatGPT.

You'll also help us use AI to manage campaigns, produce ads and analyze performance, so the team can manage more spend and run more tests with the same headcount.

What You'll Be Able to Do in a Year

Ad platforms report clicks and leads. At Zefir, you'll follow those leads through to booked meetings with Sales and use what you learn to decide where to spend.

  • Allocate €15M+ a year by cost per booked meeting. Compare costs across segments and recognise when fewer leads signal better performance.

  • Measure what your campaigns actually add. Design and interpret geo-lift or holdout tests to find out how many extra meetings a campaign generated, and use the results to move budget.

  • Run acquisition with AI. Build your own agents and automations for campaign management, ad production and performance analysis, then measure their impact.

  • Use campaign results to improve creative. Brief and challenge our agency and freelancers, then work with our Content Strategist to turn what you learn into the next round of tests.

What You'll Do

Set the paid acquisition strategy

  • Set quarterly targets with our Growth & Marketing Lead based on how sellers behave, how the market is changing and what competitors are doing.

  • Decide how to split spend across channels and campaigns to hit those targets and keep generating leads at a sustainable cost beyond the quarter.

  • Find and launch new paid channels and lead-generation partnerships.

Own daily performance and the €15M+ budget

  • Optimise campaigns daily with Sales, Brand and Product. When a campaign underperforms, reallocate spend that day.

  • Lead the weekly acquisition review: explain where we missed the plan, what drove the gap and what you'll do to close it.

  • Maximise return on the budget. Use the cost per booked sales meeting in each segment to decide where to put the next euro.

  • Work directly across Google Ads, Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, ChatGPT and new platforms, and know the tracking stack end to end, from Google Tag Manager and server-side tracking to attribution.

Measure what drives growth

  • Work with Sales, Product and Data to understand which sellers book a meeting and why, and use those findings to decide what to test and what to change.

  • Agree with Data on what counts as a booked meeting and how to attribute it.

  • Run incrementality tests, including geo-lift studies, to measure how many additional bookings campaigns generate, and compare the results with what the platforms report.

  • Keep testing new channels and campaign ideas, including new creative angles with our Content Strategist.

Work with Creative, our agency and freelancers

  • Share ownership of paid channels with our Content Strategist: they own the creative angles and assets; you own distribution, budget allocation and performance analysis.

  • Lead the work of our performance agency and freelancers. Brief them, challenge their results and decide which work to bring in-house as we grow.

Who You Are

People who do well at Zefir take initiative when the path is unclear and stay curious about the people they serve. They judge their work by its impact on revenue and put the team's results first.

You have 5+ years in performance marketing, in-house or at an agency. You've managed at least €1M a year across Meta and Google and worked directly with both platforms' account teams.

  • Good judgement under pressure: you read the data, make decisions quickly and know when to give a campaign more time.

  • Hands-on platform experience: you've run campaigns on Google Ads, Meta Ads and TikTok Ads, and you know Google Tag Manager, server-side tracking and attribution. Experience with ChatGPT Ads is a plus.

  • Commercial instinct: you want to understand what makes a seller click, book a meeting and ultimately sell. You know when fewer leads can be a good sign.

  • Strong collaboration: you work closely with creative teammates and hold agencies and freelancers to a high standard.

  • Curiosity about AI: you've used AI in your work or are eager to try it.

  • Languages: fluency in English and French.

Hiring Process

  1. 30-minute call with our Talent Lead

  2. 45-minute deep-dive with our Growth & Marketing Lead

  3. 60-minute live case with our Growth & Marketing Lead

  4. 45-minute interview with our co-founder

  5. References

Benefits

The following is for permanent employees only. For other contracts (interns, apprentices, fixed-term...), please check with your recruiter.

  • Competitive salary: You can run your own simulation with our salary calculator.

  • BSPCE (Stock Options): Available for everyone, with monthly vesting after year one, over a 4-year period.

  • Healthcare plan: Full coverage with Alan for team members, their partners, and children.

  • Office in Le Peletier, Paris (9th arrondissement): With flexible remote work options.

  • Swile meal card: €11 per worked day.

  • Swile mobility card: €45/month to support sustainable transportation (metro, carpooling, biking…).

  • Team events: Monthly events to connect and share good times, and quarterly All Hands to celebrate wins across the company.

Our Operating Principles

🏔️ Steep Mountains Are Steep: Setting ambitious goals and working hard to achieve them.

🌊 Ride Reality: Actively seeking challenges and thriving by adapting flexibly to changes.

🏀 Play for the Front of the Jersey: Prioritizing team success over individual recognition.

Application & Process

We welcome applications from anyone, regardless of background, gender, sexual orientation, religion, age, or experience. Our team values authenticity and diverse perspectives.

For all roles, our interview process emphasizes hands-on exercises, case studies, or discussions about specific examples of your previous work. We ensure objectives and expectations are clearly communicated at every step.

Qui sommes-nous

Zefir construit le pilote automatique IA de la vente immobilière en Europe, en commençant par la France. Notre agent gère chaque vente de la mise en ligne de l'annonce jusqu'à la signature définitive. Il coordonne acheteurs, vendeurs et agents immobiliers locaux, pilote la diffusion des annonces sur les portails et prend en charge toute la partie administrative. Nous aidons les propriétaires à vendre au meilleur prix, dans le calendrier qui leur convient.

Nous avons levé 60 millions d'euros auprès de Sequoia Capital et d'autres investisseurs de premier plan. Notre ambition : aider des millions d'Européens à passer à l'étape suivante de leur vie, qu'il s'agisse de déménager pour un nouveau poste ou de faire de la place pour une famille qui s'agrandit.

L'équipe

Tu travailles avec une équipe de trois personnes, dont un ops et un manager, qui récupère les commissions dues à Zefir et améliore en continu les process de recouvrement.

Le rôle

Récupérer les commissions dues à Zefir par la négociation amiable, jusqu'au protocole signé, avant le contentieux. Les dossiers sont déjà prêts : à toi d'appeler. Ton indicateur de réussite : le montant recouvré chaque mois, avec un objectif mensuel indexé sur le montant des protocoles signés.

Ce que tu feras

  • Mener les appels de recouvrement et négocier jusqu'à l'accord, dans le cadre fixé (montant, plancher, concessions).

  • Produire et envoyer les écrits (mails de suivi, mises en demeure AR24, protocoles transactionnels, dossiers de pièces) avec les outils fournis.

  • Tenir à jour le pipe dans HubSpot (étapes, état des négociations, montants signés), soit une trentaine de dossiers.

  • Contribuer avec l'équipe à l'amélioration des process de recouvrement.

Pour toi si

  • Tu sais négocier au téléphone avec des interlocuteurs hostiles ou contrariés : ce sont des conversations exigeantes.

  • Tu es rigoureux·se sur les documents et tu structures ton recouvrement à partir des pièces fournies.

  • Tu écris de façon claire et sobre, y compris des écrits juridiques, avec les outils fournis. Une formation juridique est un plus, pas un impératif.

  • Tu sais mener et suivre une trentaine de dossiers en parallèle avec des délais stricts.

  • Tu es à l'aise avec les outils : HubSpot, transcriptions d'appels, Claude.

  • Une première expérience de recouvrement d'impayés est un plus.

Conditions de la mission

  • Mission freelance, avec une forte autonomie : tu pilotes l'activité avec un ops et un manager

  • Sur site, Paris 9e, 5 jours sur 5

  • Durée : 1 mois renouvelable

  • Rémunération : TJM fixe de 200 € et jusqu'à 150 € de variable par jour, versé à 100 % si l'objectif de recouvrement est atteint, soit jusqu'à 350 € par jour

Nos principes

🏔️ Steep Mountains Are Steep : se fixer des objectifs ambitieux et travailler dur pour les atteindre.

🌊 Ride Reality : aller chercher les difficultés et s'adapter vite quand la réalité change.

🏀 Play for the Front of the Jersey : faire passer la réussite de l'équipe avant la reconnaissance individuelle.

Candidature et process

Nous accueillons les candidatures de toutes et tous, quels que soient le parcours, le genre, l'orientation sexuelle, la religion, l'âge ou l'expérience. Notre équipe valorise l'authenticité et la diversité des points de vue.

Nos entretiens reposent sur des mises en situation, des cas pratiques ou des exemples concrets de ton travail passé. Les objectifs et les attentes sont clairs à chaque étape.

data.title: Inbound Sales 🇫🇷
data.description:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⚡ The Inbound Sales 🇫🇷 role

We're growing our Inbound Sales team in France.

Our Inbound Sales team is in charge of closing inbound requests from leads with 1 to 5 employees (Independent workers, very small companies, individuals).

You’ll be in charge of the whole sales cycle from qualification to closing by educating prospects and providing inspiring arguments to transform them into convinced customers.

At the same time, we expect you to understand, embrace and apply the Alan Smart & Soft selling method. This method stems from the concept that the prospect experience is an inseparable piece of the overall Alan customer experience. You are expected to make this experience pleasant, instructive and delightful by leveraging the most relevant messaging and materials (Smart) and by defining the high-touch strategy that suits best each prospect (Soft).

We also expect you to look at the big picture and help us grow and improve as a company. For that, you’ll have to be real team players even beyond your role. You’ll be expected to challenge us to improve our product(s), our methods, and our strategy, and get involved in other projects and initiatives relevant to growing our customer base.

What does make this role exciting :

  • You will close deals every single day of the year, which is very stimulating!

  • The Inbound Sales team is quite recent: You will contribute to building a new practice within the Sales Community, getting involved in tooling and process improvements

  • You will help building the playbook of best practices to close deals in one shot

  • You will contribute to making our products even better by sharing feedback and improving the self-serve experience for our members

  • You will become an insurance expert and learn to master our products in order to confidently answer questions & objections from prospects

  • We invest heavily in AI to transform the Sales practice. You'll have the opportunity to become one of the most modern Sales professionals in the market!

⭐ You will be a great fit for this role if you: 

  • Have 1-2 years of experience in a Sales role including closing experience

  • Have full working proficiency in French (C2 and above), and advanced level in English

  • Are highly organized with exceptional follow-up skills

  • Show a great balance between Active Listening and Assertiveness when interacting with your prospects

  • Have natural empathy and are passionate about understanding and solving prospects' problems

  • Have a positive attitude and ability to collaborate in a small team

  • Have a desire to learn fast and make an impact from day 1

  • Are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the A2-B1 level range.

Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team.

🙌   Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers. 

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

  • Flexible office with hybrid setup. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Generous transit benefit

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only.

Important note: we hire people not roles. 

After reading this job description, if you feel like you don’t have all the necessary prerequisites but that it matches where you are now or what you'd like to grow into in your next position, we encourage you to apply!

Not everybody will enter our recruitment process, but all, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

  3. Activate partners and generate business opportunities: Build engagement plans, support partner enablement and work closely with Sales to turn recommendations into qualified opportunities.

  4. Help scale the Accountant Partnerships model: Manage partner performance, share insights with internal teams and contribute to the development of scalable playbooks, tools and processes.

  • Experience managing partnerships throughout the full lifecycle, from prospecting and closing to activation and ongoing relationship management

  • Experience managing a portfolio of partners, ideally in a fast-growing company

  • Strong negotiation, communication, presentation and relationship-building skills

  • A data-oriented mindset, with the ability to track performance and prioritise opportunities

  • The ability to collaborate effectively with Sales, Marketing, Product, Data and Operations teams

  • An entrepreneurial mindset, strong ownership and the ability to work autonomously

  • Full professional fluency in French and professional fluency in English

Experience working directly with accounting firms, payroll providers, HR software or insurance companies would be a strong plus.

We are particularly interested in candidates who have experience with B2B distribution partnerships, where a third party recommends or distributes a solution to its own customers. Experience limited to technology integrations, co-marketing or visibility partnerships would be less relevant for this role.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

Marketing Ops is one of Alan's highest-leverage functions.

It sits at the intersection of marketing strategy, data, and technology — turning systems into growth engines and ensuring every touchpoint with prospects and members is timely, relevant, and scalable.

Alan is growing fast across France, Belgium, Spain, and Canada. But today we're leaving value on the table. On the prospect side, we drive more traffic but can't convert it properly: no scoring, no intelligent routing, no nurturing that adapts to buying intent. On the member side, messaging is one of our primary touchpoints for engagement, retention, and trust — yet nobody operates it strategically. Personalization stays shallow, communication pressure goes unmonitored, and shipping a message often means filing an engineering ticket.

We need Marketing Ops leaders who can architect scalable systems, operate them strategically, and progressively embed AI into workflows — to raise quality, reduce manual execution, and unlock growth without scaling headcount linearly.

⭐️ The Marketing Ops job ⭐️

We are hiring two Marketing Operations Managers, each embedded in a different crew:

  • Growth Infrastructure — focused on prospect acquisition: building a unified lead engine that captures, scores, routes, and nurtures across all channels

  • Product Platform — focused on member lifecycle messaging: operating Alan's messaging stack as a scalable service across 1.7M+ profiles

Both roles share the same DNA: strong marketing ops fundamentals, data fluency, a product mindset, and the ability to be both hands-on and strategic. Crew placement will be determined based on the candidate's experience, interests, and fit during the hiring process.

Why is this role interesting?

  • Speed: marketing, product, and sales teams ship campaigns and messages confidently — Marketing Ops turns bottlenecks into force multipliers across every crew

  • Trust: clean data, governed attributes, proper segmentation, and enforced rules mean the right person gets the right message at the right time

  • Scale: as we grow to millions of members across multiple countries, we need operators who keep our platforms clean and the user experience protected — without scaling headcount linearly

  • AI at the frontier: this isn't a maintenance role — you'll identify high-priority use cases for AI agents, train and refine them to a senior marketer's quality bar, and drive real adoption

What will you do with us?

You'll be a partnership with marketers — not a service desk. You'll partner closely with engineers, data, designers, and cross-functional stakeholders (PMMs, sales, growth, product) within a PM-Tech duo crew model.

Regardless of crew, you will own a core set of capabilities:

  • Marketing Automation & CRM: own and optimize our marketing stack (Customer.io, CRM integrations); build automations that enable marketers to launch campaigns independently, at scale, across all geos

  • Data Model & Governance: maintain CRM data quality, attribute/event design, and database hygiene as a sustained practice

  • Segmentation & Lifecycle Design: design and maintain lifecycle stages, segmentation logic, routing rules, and re-engagement flows across multiple audiences and geos

  • Nurturing Infrastructure: own the nurturing stack and campaign processes; make launches autonomous and compliant

  • AI-First Operations: identify, build, and refine AI agents for email copywriting, lead scoring, next-best-action recommendations, and content generation — making marketers AI-powered, not replacing them

  • Performance Monitoring: track the full funnel from first touchpoint to conversion; identify leakage and prioritize from data

  • Documentation & Enablement: create playbooks, train teams on tools and processes, reduce the marginal cost of new campaigns

Then, depending on your crew:

Growth Infrastructure — you'll build a unified lead engine (no more tool-by-tool silos), design lead scoring and routing models, crack multi-channel activation (email, WhatsApp, Voice AI), build AI agents that pre-qualify and enrich leads, and maintain a live feedback loop with BDRs, AEs, and Inbound Sales.

Product Platform — you'll operate Customer.io and back-end triggered emails as one governed system, monitor communication pressure and enforce channel rules, define and enforce recipient lifecycle paths, drive 100% Design Studio adoption, and co-own outbound messaging strategy with PMMs and product teams.

By your first year, we'll know it worked when:

  • At least one AI agent is in production on a key use case (email nurturing, lead categorization, content generation), with a second scoped or live, and adoption is real

  • Any marketer or product Alaner can launch a campaign or ship a message without bottlenecking through ops or engineering

  • CRM data model, attributes, and segments are properly owned, documented, and clean — the data we see is data we can act on

  • Every contact has a documented path through our messaging — segmentation is sharp, messaging is relevant, and pressure is monitored

  • Marketing's contribution to acquisition and engagement is visible and quantifiable, from first touch to conversion


⭐️ Is it you we are looking for? ⭐️


You'll be a great fit for this opportunity if you:

  • Have 5+ years in Marketing operations, growth ops, CRM ops, lifecycle marketing, or lead generation in a tech environment (B2B, B2C, or B2B2C)

  • Have hands-on experience managing marketing automation platforms at scale (Customer.io, Braze, Iterable, HubSpot, Marketo, Pardot, Salesforce, or equivalent)

  • Have a strong understanding of CRM data models — attribute/event design and data hygiene as a sustained practice

  • Can frame and implement processes for lead scoring, nurturing, segmentation, and personalization

  • Have a product knack: you can define what's not working, identify what to build next, and see problems as opportunities to bring more value

  • Bring data fluency and analytical rigor: you read platform and campaign data, surface anomalies, and draw business insights

  • Can be both hands-on and think strategically — you drive the big picture while staying close to execution

  • Have strong stakeholder management skills — you'll partner daily with engineering, product, sales, and marketing teams

  • Can manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-moving environment

  • Communicate with excellent written and spoken English

  • Are impact-driven with a strong bias towards improving processes

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the C0-D level range.

🙌 Perks & Benefits

La Clinique Alan réunit plus de 120 professionnels de santé disponibles 7j/7 : médecins généralistes, sages-femmes, psychologues, kinésithérapeutes, dermatologues, pédiatres, nutritionnistes, infirmières puéricultrices.

  • 🩺 Téléconsultation vidéo : pour les situations qui nécessitent une consultation médicale en direct

  • 💬 Chat médical : conseils de professionnels de santé, 7j/7, réponse en moins de 30 minutes

  • 🤖 Mo, notre compagnon santé IA : répond instantanément aux questions du quotidien, avec des réponses relues et validées par nos médecins

  • 🎯 Des programmes de prévention (mal de dos, gestion du stress) : guidés et personnalisés

Nous recrutons des médecins généralistes à l'aise avec la médecine à distance et motivé(e)s à rejoindre notre service de chat médical - pour accompagner nos membres avec des conseils médicaux de qualité, mais aussi pour contribuer à la revue médicale de notre compagnon de santé.

  • ✅ Enthousisate à l’idée d’intégrer l’IA dans sa pratique.

  • ✅ Convaincu(e) que prévention et accompagnement changent vraiment la vie des patients

data.title: Head of Marketing, ET Academy
data.description:
À propos d'ET Academy

ET Academy est la formation créée par Eva ----- 347 000 abonnés sur Instagram), créatrice de contenu voyage. Elle apprend aux créatrices à vivre de leur contenu : trouver des marques, décrocher des collaborations rémunérées, lancer leurs propres offres.

Nous proposons deux programmes, Formation et Coaching, vendus en appel par notre équipe sales. Notre acquisition repose sur le contenu organique d'Eva (plus de 1,5 million de vues par semaine sur Instagram), sur nos tunnels (VSL, formations gratuites, ressources ManyChat, communauté Skool, live hebdomadaire) et sur la publicité Meta.

Le défi

Nous générons beaucoup de leads, mais pas assez de leads qualifiés qui passent à l'achat. Ton rôle est de régler ça, sur trois axes :

  • La pertinence des tunnels : chaque étape, de l'opt‑in au rendez‑vous sales, doit attirer et qualifier les bons profils.

  • Le ciblage : identifier les profils qui convertissent vraiment et orienter les audiences en conséquence.

  • L'idéation : créatives publicitaires, structure des contenus, des posts et des stories.

Tes missions

Ads et acquisition payante

  • Piloter le Business Manager Meta en autonomie : structure des campagnes, audiences, pixel et événements, budget d'environ 5 000 € par mois.

  • Trouver les angles, écrire les scripts et les accroches, produire ou briefer les créas (vidéo, statique, UGC) avec l'appui de l'IA.

Contenu et organique

Tunnels et qualification

  • Auditer chaque tunnel (VSL, formations gratuites, ressources, pages d'opt‑in, questions de qualification) et prioriser les améliorations.

  • Travailler main dans la main avec le Head of Sales sur la qualité des leads, le taux de prise de rendez‑vous et le taux de présence aux appels.

  • Automatiser ce qui peut l'être (ManyChat, emails, relances) en tirant parti de l'IA, notamment Claude.

Tracking, data et attribution

  • Mettre en place un tracking très précis de bout en bout, du contenu et des ads jusqu'aux tunnels, au setting et au closing, pour attribuer chaque vente à sa vraie source.

  • Suivre les performances de chaque tunnel : coût par lead, taux de qualification, prise de rendez‑vous, présence, closing.

  • Construire et tenir le reporting marketing, et le présenter chaque semaine à l'équipe.

  • Repérer dans les données les leviers d'optimisation, les prioriser et les mettre en œuvre.

  • Linux Skills: Direct experience with Linux/Unix command-line navigation, system administration utilities, log parsing, and remote diagnostics.

  • Infrastructure & Networking: Experience navigating hybrid environments combining physical hardware, TCP/IP networking (DNS, VPNs, firewalls, VLANs), and cloud services.

  • Incident Communication: Experience providing technical timelines and status updates to internal stakeholders during critical incidents.

  • Languages: Professional fluency in English. French language proficiency is an asset.

  • Flexibility: Availability to participate in a scheduled night and weekend on-call rotation.

Analyze the problem to solve and do bibliography
Design and proposal of new modules/improvement of existing modules
Create an evaluation database to ensure the quality of your module
Development and integration to our C++ Software
SW testing (Unit testing, performance characterization, system testing, …) and documentation

To excel in this role, you should possess the following qualifications:
 
Education: Master's in Computer Science or a related field.
Experience: +2 years experience as Algorithm Engineer or in a similar role, showcasing a history of successful algorithm development.
Programming Skills: Proficiency in a programming language such as C++ with the ability to write clean and efficient code.

data.title: Senior Business Data Scientist - Data & Transformation services
data.description:
Ekimetrics is a global leader in Marketing & Commercial effectiveness and AI-powered solutions. Since 2006, we’ve been helping businesses optimize marketing and operations by combining AI with business and tech expertise across 4 domains: Marketing & commercial effectiveness, Customer analytics, Operational excellence, ESG & sustainability.
 
With a full in-house team and offices in Paris, London, New York, Hong Kong, and Shanghai, we deliver tailor-made solutions that turn data into real positive impact, leveraging our unique combination of technology and services.
 
We excel at delivering AI impact at scale. Our mission is to harness this power to tackle the world’s most urgent issues. We commit to responsibility and frugality in AI, systematic AI impact at scale, and loyalty to our values and DNA. 

You join as Senior Business Scientist within our Data & AI Transformation Services (DATS). You bridge business, consulting, AI & data expertise: you frame high-value use cases, turn business needs into AI opportunities, and drive adoption. You work alongside AI, Data and Software Engineers.

Clients' Projects

  • Lead the day-to-day relationship with business and CDO/CIO sponsors, and understand their strategic and operational challenges.
  • Frame high-value Data & AI use cases and translate business needs into AI opportunities, from AI ambition and roadmap to Proof of Value and MVP.
  • Depending on the engagement, act as Data & AI Product Owner: own the product vision and backlog, prioritize with business sponsors, write and accept user stories, steer the squad's delivery with the Tech Lead from Proof of Value to MVP and production, and own the related delivery governance and planning.
  • Align business teams, leadership and ExCo around the AI roadmap and the transformation priorities.
  • Own the business value and adoption of the solutions built by the squad: operating model, usage, impact measurement, Responsible AI and governance. Challenge their feasibility and industrialization with the Tech Lead and the Tech Engineers; you do not build the models yourself, but you are technical enough to challenge and steer GenAI, LLM, agentic and ML solutions.
  • Contribute to the Transformation Cockpit: maturity measurement, adoption KPIs and steering of AI value over time.
  • Work within a multidisciplinary squad (Tech Lead, AI/Data/Software Engineers), apply Ekimetrics' DATS methods, templates and deliverables, and tailor them to each client.
  • Coordinate the business side of the squad and monitor delivery and profitability with manager support.

Strategic Projects

  • Develop and share best practices, methodologies and DATS assets (how-tos, templates, typical deliverables) across the Data & AI Transformation community.
  • Stay up to date with AI, GenAI, ML and agentic technologies, and with their impact on business models and operating models.
  • Contribute to internal AI initiatives, accelerators and thought leadership.

Business Development

  • Identify opportunities for Data & AI transformation within existing client accounts (upsell and cross-sell).
  • Contribute to account development, renewals and project scoping, alongside the Partner.
  • Contribute to RFPs, proposals and pitches.
  • Support the development of new DATS offerings and use cases.

Transversal & People Development

  • Contribute to recruitment, onboarding and development of Data & AI Transformation talent.
  • Mentor and coach Junior Business Scientists and interns.
  • Develop and deliver internal AI / Data training and knowledge-sharing sessions.

Profile

  • Senior level: you have already led client engagements, coordinated a team and contributed to business development.
  • Hybrid business-tech profile: you can connect business value, data, AI/GenAI, technology and adoption, and talk credibly with both sponsors and engineers.
  • Proven product ownership experience on data or AI products (backlog, prioritization, agile delivery).
  • Experience facing senior stakeholders and driving change or transformation, beyond the delivery of pilots.
Why join us?
 
At Ekimetrics, we believe your ideas truly matter. Here, your ideas are yours to build and bring to life. We embrace an entrepreneurial spirit, encouraging you to push boundaries to achieve meaningful impact. But it’s not just about individual success—we thrive on collaboration and enriching one another.

Together, we’re constantly learning and growing, whether through personalized career paths and training, challenging projects, mentorship, or simply through the diverse perspectives we bring to the table.

And perhaps more importantly, we believe in enjoying what we do. Ekimetrics is a stimulating and safe environment where you can thrive as your authentic self.

In 2023, Ekimetrics obtained the “mission-driven company” status, reflecting our strong commitment to CSR.
Our purpose: Accelerate organizations’ transformation towards sustainability, through the application of data science and artificial intelligence.

We were also certified Great Place to Work© in France, the United Kingdom, and the United States in 2023, and our Hong Kong office received the Best Companies to Work for in Asia 2023© award.

Ekimetrics is part of the French Tech 120 ranking. We have been selected by La French Tech to join the prestigious group of the top 120 French scale-ups, recognized for their potential to become international leaders.
 
You will have access to:
 
·       The Eki.Academy training catalog, which contains programs that will enhance your skills on our solutions and jobs, learning paths on our digital platform, as well as programs dedicated to our priority challenges, including awareness of environmental issues with the Climate School;
·       A sporty, artistic, musical, playful, charitable, and committed life: from our private gym to art exhibitions, video games, and concerts, or even CSR challenges on our dedicated platform (Vendredi);
·       Many events and seminars to stay close to your community;

data.title: Product Owner (H/F/N)
data.description:
Les entreprises qui performent décident mieux. Depuis 2006, Ekimetrics aide les organisations à transformer leurs décisions en avantage concurrentiel durable grâce à des solutions d’IA. Notre double ambition est d’allier performance et durabilité, pour construire un leadership pérenne. 

Nos solutions sont une combinaison unique de People et de technologie. Notre plateforme Eki.Decisions complète l’expertise de nos équipes en marketing, efficacité commerciale et data science, pour connecter l’IA aux décisions qui structurent toute l’organisation. 

Avec une équipe 100% internalisée et des bureaux à Paris, Londres, New York, Hong Kong et Shanghai, nous nous engageons pour une IA responsable et frugale, pour garantir un avantage concurrentiel constant, et pour rester fidèles à nos valeurs et à notre ADN. 

Vous rejoignez l’équipe Produit – R&PD 

Au sein de l’équipe R&PD (Research & Product Development) nous concevons et industrialisons des solutions Data & IA SaaS à fort impact business, qui répondent aux enjeux de nos clients grâce à l’analytics, la data science et l’intelligence artificielle.

A ce titre, nous recrutons un·e Product Owner pour notre solution Marketing Effectiveness avec pour objectif de structurer la  roadmap produit, maximiser son adoption, son time-to-market et la valeur délivrée à nos clients. 

Votre rôle dans l’équipe 

Product Owner de notre solution Marketing Effectiveness (Eki.Decisions), vous transformez les besoins business, marché et utilisateurs en fonctionnalités concrètes, documentées et alignées sur une logique de plateforme commune. 

Vous travaillez au quotidien avec le Product Manager, les équipes engineering et data, ainsi que les équipes projet et delivery, pour construire une solution fiable, adoptée et scalable. 

Vos principales missions 

Piloter le backlog et le delivery 

  • Structurer, prioriser et maintenir le backlog de la solution 

  • Rédiger les user stories, spécifications fonctionnelles et critères d’acceptance 

  • Clarifier les besoins avec l’engineering et accompagner chaque livraison de bout en bout 

  • Suivre l’avancement, lever les blocages et sécuriser les engagements 

  • Animer les rituels agiles : refinement, sprint planning, reviews, rétrospectives, synchronisations produit/tech 

  • Rendre la roadmap, les priorités et les arbitrages lisibles pour toutes les parties prenantes 

Contribuer à la vision produit 

  • Co-construire la vision et la roadmap avec le Product Manager 

  • Traduire les enjeux business et marché en opportunités produit concrètes : fonctionnalités, parcours utilisateurs, briques mutualisées, standards d’expérience 

  • Prioriser selon la valeur business, l’impact client, la contribution à la platformisation et la capacité à accélérer le time-to-market 

Participer à la product discovery 

  • Comprendre les besoins des utilisateurs et des clients sur le Marketing Effectiveness 

  • Maîtriser les usages, comportements et règles métier qui font la valeur de la solution 

  • Identifier les enjeux fonctionnels et opérationnels : expérience utilisateur, cohérence des parcours, adoption, scalabilité, industrialisation 

  • Conduire ou contribuer aux activités de discovery : interviews, retours terrain, analyses d’usage, benchmarks 

Faire adopter et améliorer en continu 

  • Accompagner le déploiement des nouvelles fonctionnalités auprès des parties prenantes clés, avec une communication claire sur ce qui est livré 

  • Mesurer l’impact : adoption, satisfaction, valeur délivrée aux clients 

  • Animer la boucle de feedback avec les équipes Produit, Business, Tech et Delivery 

  • S’appuyer sur les outils de tracking pour monitorer les usages et prioriser de façon data-driven 

  • Garantir la qualité : documentation produit, release notes, support, monitoring d’usage 

Collaborer en transverse 

  • Travailler avec les équipes Produit, Tech, Data, IA et Delivery pour assurer la cohérence des solutions émergentes avec la plateforme 

  • Servir de relais entre les équipes business, produit, engineering et delivery 

  • Participer aux démonstrations, formations internes, retours d’expérience et communications produit 

Votre profil 

Expérience 

  • 3 ans minimum en tant que Product Owner ou Product Manager 

  • Expérience sur des produits SaaS ou digitaux, idéalement dans un environnement data, IA ou tech

Compétences 

  • Forte appétence business : vous reliez les fonctionnalités à la valeur client et aux enjeux marché 

  • Aisance avec les profils tech : vous comprenez les enjeux d’un produit technique, sans avoir besoin d’être développeur·se 

  • Maîtrise du backlog : clarifier les besoins, prioriser des sujets complexes, suivre le delivery 

  • Logique de plateforme : mutualisation des usages, convergence des solutions, cohérence des parcours 

  • Sensibilité forte à l’expérience utilisateur, à l’adoption et à la qualité produit 

  • Capacité à vulgariser et à embarquer les parties prenantes autour d’une vision commune 

Savoir-être 

  • Organisé·e, rigoureux·se, autonome, curieux·se et orienté·e impact 

Langues 

  • Français et anglais courants, à l’écrit comme à l’oral 

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?  

Chez Ekimetrics, vos idées comptent vraiment et vous appartiennent: à vous de leur donner vie. Nous cultivons un esprit entrepreneurial qui vous encourage à repousser les limites pour créer un impact significatif. 

Mais il ne s’agit pas seulement de réussites individuelles : nous avançons ensemble, en nous enrichissant mutuellement. Ensemble, nous apprenons et progressons en continu, que ce soit à travers des parcours de carrière personnalisés, des projets stimulants, du mentorat, ou simplement grâce à la diversité des perspectives que chacun.e apporte.

Et surtout, nous croyons au plaisir dans le travail. Ekimetrics est un environnement stimulant et bienveillant, où chacun.e peut s’épanouir en étant pleinement soi-même.

En 2023, Ekimetrics a obtenu le statut d’entreprise à mission qui témoigne de notre ambition forte en matière de RSE. Notre raison d’être : Faire de la data science et de l’intelligence artificielle l’accélérateur de la transformation durable des organisations.

Ekimetrics fait partie du classement French Tech 120 ! Nous avons été sélectionnés par La French Tech pour rejoindre le prestigieux groupe des 120 scale-ups françaises les plus performantes, avec un fort potentiel pour devenir des leaders internationaux.  

Vous aurez accès :

  • Au catalogue de formation Eki.Academy qui contient des programmes qui vous feront monter en compétences sur nos solutions et nos métiers, des parcours apprenants sur notre plateforme digitale ainsi que des programmes dédiés à nos enjeux prioritaires, dont la sensibilisation aux sujets environnementaux avec la Climate School.
  • A une vie sportive, artistique, musicale, ludique, caritative et engagée : de notre salle de sport privatisée à nos expositions d’art, en passant par des jeux vidéo et des concerts, ou encore les défis RSE sur la plateforme Vendredi. Toutes ces initiatives sont portées par nos Eki.People.
  • De nombreux évènements et séminaires pour rester proche de votre communauté.
  • Des locaux chaleureux dans un quartier dynamique au cœur de Paris (Grands boulevards).

data.title: Senior DevSecOps Engineer
data.description:
Our Security and IT team keeps the 360Learning platform secure, compliant and auditable for the 1,500 organisations that learn on it every day. As a Senior DevSecOps Engineer, your mission is to make our infrastructure secure by design, detectable by default, and provable at audit time.

360Learning runs its learning platform on Azure and Kubernetes, certified ISO 27001:2022 and SOC 2 Type II. Over the past two years the technical security workload has grown on every front: a larger and more regulated customer base sending their own scans and security assessments, a wider detection and response scope, more infrastructure to keep hardened and auditable, and a growing backlog of security engineering projects that never reach the top of the queue.

We are creating this position to add real technical capacity on the infrastructure side of security, and to move part of our security posture from manual effort to automated guardrails. You will be the bridge between security and platform engineering: deep enough in infrastructure to fix things yourself, and close enough to security operations to know what to look for.

“Ours is a small, senior team with a broad scope: information security, compliance, infrastructure governance and internal tooling, with dual audit accountability on ISO 27001:2022 and SOC 2 Type II. That means direct impact and no layers between you and the decision. Roughly half of this role is greenfield build work you will own end to end.” Guillaume Seigneuret, CISO and Hiring Coach.


Within 1 month, you will:

  • Complete our onboarding and learn how we work through our own platform and our Convexity culture

  • Map our Azure and AKS environment, our detection and logging coverage, and our ISO 27001 and SOC 2 control scope with the CISO and the Security Engineer

  • Meet the DevOps, platform engineering and IT teams you will work with daily

  • Shadow alert triage and one customer security assessment end to end


    • Within 3 months, you will:

  • Be autonomous on our AKS and Azure environment and handle infrastructure related alerts end to end

  • Have shipped at least one concrete hardening or automation improvement in production

  • Own the infrastructure scope of vulnerability management, from triage to remediation follow up


    • Within 6 months, you will:

  • Have the honeypot live and producing high fidelity alerts

  • Have measurably widened SIEM connector coverage, with documented log sources and retention

  • Run infrastructure vulnerability remediation on a predictable cycle with SLA reporting


    • Within 12 months, you will:

  • Manage detection content as code, with reviewed and tested rules and documented runbooks

  • Have largely automated audit evidence on the infrastructure scope

  • Have eliminated long lived credentials on the critical paths, so engineering teams ship on secure defaults they did not have to think about


    • The Skill Set:

  • 5+ years in infrastructure, cloud or platform engineering with a strong security focus, or in security engineering with hands on infrastructure practice

  • Production experience with Kubernetes: RBAC, network policies, admission controllers, secrets handling, workload identity, runtime security

  • Solid cloud experience, ideally Azure. Strong AWS or Google Cloud experience with a genuine interest in converting works too

data.title: Founding Product Manager
data.description:
Who we are

Lemrock builds the infrastructure of agentic commerce.

Tomorrow, consumers won't just buy on e-commerce websites. They will discover, compare and purchase directly inside conversational AI interfaces like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and a growing long tail of specialized AI assistants.

For brands, this is a major shift: if they are not present in these environments, they become invisible.

Our mission: enable any brand to exist, sell and distribute in this new channel.

We raised a €7M seed round (the first in Europe on this market), with Jean-Baptiste Rudelle, founder of Criteo, on our board, and the Bpifrance DeepTech label.

Today, Lemrock is already:

  • 100M+ conversations per month

  • 150+ brand clients

  • a $100B market structuring at high speed

The role

Product at Lemrock has been driven by the founders so far. As our first Product Manager, you'll work directly with the founders and our CTO to shape the product vision, own a core part of the product end to end, and build the practice that takes us from idea to shipped.

You'll start by owning the brand-facing product, and your scope will grow fast from there.

Your mission

  • Shape the vision: bring your own conviction to the product strategy with the founders, from what we bet on next to what we stop doing.

  • Own the roadmap end to end: turn strategy into a living, prioritized roadmap, and decide what we don't build so the team stays on the highest-impact work.

  • Run discovery: spend real time with brands, partners and the field, find the problems worth solving, and validate before we build.

  • Ship with the team: work shoulder-to-shoulder with engineering and design to scope, prototype, and ship weekly, not quarterly.

  • Own launches and outcomes: drive rollout, watch the data, onboard the business teams, and judge your work by what it moved, not by what shipped.

  • Build the product function itself: the rituals, the prioritization, the feedback loop from the field.

What we're looking for

  • 3 to 8 years in product, at least part of it at a startup or scale-up, ideally as an early or first PM. You've taken something from a vague problem to a shipped, used feature, and owned its results.

  • A generalist comfortable owning the messy middle: discovery one hour, scoping with engineers the next, writing the launch note after that.

  • A bias for action: you make calls with incomplete data, ship, and iterate from what real users do.

  • Customer obsession that shows up in your decisions.

  • AI-native: you already build with tools like Claude, Cursor, v0 or Lovable to prototype, research, synthesize, and move the roadmap faster.

  • Able to learn a lot, fast, in a deep and complex environment.

  • Fluent French and professional English.

  • Based in Paris, with the team at the office (up to 1 day remote per week).

Bonus

  • You've built in e-commerce, marketplaces, adtech, or AI/agent products, or you're genuinely fascinated by agentic commerce.

  • A technical background (ex-software engineer or CS), so you can go deep with the team and direct AI tools effectively.

Why join us

  • Join a company in early breakout mode, already generating revenue with a clear edge.

  • Be part of the next structural shift of the web: agentic commerce.

  • Work directly with experienced, ambitious founders, and own the product from day one.

  • Shape both the product and how we build it.

What we offer

  • Competitive salary, based on experience

  • Equity (BSPCE)

  • Meal vouchers with Swile

  • Alan health insurance

  • 7 weeks of vacation (RTT included)

  • 50% transportation coverage

data.title: Data Migration Project Manager
data.description:
À propos de Dastra

Dastra est une plateforme SaaS dédiée à la protection des données, à la compliance et à la gouvernance de l’IA.

Notre mission est claire : Faire de la protection des données une réalité opérationnelle, en plaçant la confiance au cœur des stratégies des entreprises.

Nous aidons les organisations à maîtriser leurs risques pour innover, en transformant des obligations réglementaires complexes (RGPD, IA) en processus simples, concrets et actionnables.

Le rôle

En tant que Data Migration Project Manager, tu pilotes les projets de migration des données clients vers Dastra, du cadrage jusqu'à la livraison.

À la croisée de la gestion de projet, de la data et du conseil client, ton rôle est majoritairement orienté pilotage et accompagnement client (environ 70 %), tout en étant suffisamment à l'aise avec la data et la technique pour comprendre, structurer et mapper les données.

Tes missions

Piloter tes projets de migration de A à Z

  • Piloter plusieurs projets clients simultanément, du cadrage à la livraison, en priorisant efficacement pour garantir un suivi fluide et de qualité.

  • Piloter le suivi et l’avancement des projets à travers des meetings clients

  • Comprendre les enjeux métier et Privacy du client afin d’adapter la stratégie de migration à son contexte et à ses besoins.

  • Accompagner le client dans les choix techniques et data nécessaires à sa migration

  • Sécuriser chaque étape de la migration, de la préparation des données jusqu’à leur intégration dans Dastra

Comprendre & structurer la data

  • Analyser et structurer les données sources du client

  • Construire le mapping entre les données clients et le modèle de données Dastra

  • Définir et paramétrer les règles de transformation nécessaires à la migration

  • Contrôler les données tout au long du processus de migration

  • Comprendre la logique des scripts et des flux de données

  • Maîtriser notre outil interne de migration

Notre outil interne automatise désormais une grande partie des transformations auparavant réalisées via des scripts spécifiques : nous ne cherchons donc pas un développeur, mais quelqu'un qui comprend suffisamment la technique pour prendre les bonnes décisions.

Collaborer avec les équipes Dastra

Tu travailles notamment avec :

  • les Sales, en avant-vente, pour apporter l’expertise Data Migration nécessaire au cadrage du projet et rassurer les prospects

  • les équipes Tech, sur les problématiques d'intégration et de fonctionnement de la plateforme ; 

  • les Privacy Success Managers, pour assurer une transition fluide après la migration et transmettre les enjeux et règles métier du client. 

Le profil recherché

  • Minimum 2/3 d'expérience en gestion de projets migration clients (implémentation, migration, intégration ou transformation de données)

  • Une expérience indispensable en gestion multiprojet et multiclient, idéalement en cabinet de conseil, ESN ou environnement SaaS 

  • Une connaissance des enjeux RGPD / Privacy et du métier de DPO, acquise dans un contexte professionnel

  • Une bonne culture IT & data : mapping, structuration de données, logique de scripts, compréhension des flux et architectures 

  • Une capacité à prendre rapidement en main un nouvel outil et à comprendre son fonctionnement

  • À l'aise pour conseiller, challenger et vulgariser auprès d'interlocuteurs techniques et métier 

  • Anglais C2 indispensable 

Ce qui fera la différence

Tu es curieux·se, autonome et débrouillard·e : face à un nouvel outil ou une problématique que tu ne connais pas, tu cherches, tu comprends et tu proposes.

Tu apprécies autant comprendre comment fonctionne une plateforme que piloter un projet et accompagner un client jusqu'à sa réussite.

Tu as, à minima, une expérience auprès de DPO, équipes Privacy/Compliance ou sur un logiciel GRC/Privacy.

Pourquoi rejoindre Dastra ?

  • Un rôle clé et autonome, au cœur des projets de migration clients 

  • Un poste hybride : 70 % projet & client, avec une vraie dimension data/technique 

  • Des outils innovants qui automatisent la technique pour se concentrer sur la valeur 

  • Des sujets stratégiques : Data, Privacy, RGPD et IA 

  • De l’impact et de la liberté pour proposer, améliorer et faire évoluer les pratiques

Rémunération & conditions

  • Entre 45 et 55k annuel brut, selon profil et expérience, à discuter

  • Paris 1er / Télétravail hybride (3j/2j)

  • 5 semaines de congés payés + 10 jours de RTT 

  • TR+ mutuelle d’entreprise 

  • 1 séminaire par an + des teams buildings à gogo

Processus de recrutement

  1. Préqualification RH

  2. Entretien métier avec Mathieu, Data Migration Lead

  3. Mise en situation (en visio) avec Mathieu et Jérôme, Directeur des Opérations & Co-fondateur

  4. Échange avec les autres co-fondateurs

  5. Contrôles de références

data.title: Stage Développement C++ & Intelligence Artificielle générative
data.description:
Dans le cadre de l’évolution de notre logiciel Track Builder, outil d’aide à la génération de lignes ferroviaires destinées à la simulation, nous recherchons un(e) stagiaire de fin d’études pour concevoir un framework intelligent de migration et de compatibilité logicielle, développé en C++ et assisté par l’Intelligence Artificielle.

Le Track Builder évolue régulièrement, entraînant des modifications de son architecture, de ses modèles de données, de ses couches SIG (QGIS), de ses formats de configuration (XML/XSD) et de ses composants logiciels. Ces évolutions nécessitent de garantir la compatibilité des projets existants avec les nouvelles versions de l'application, tout en préservant l'intégrité des données.

L'objectif du stage est de concevoir un framework générique capable d'analyser les différences entre deux versions du logiciel, d'identifier les transformations nécessaires et d'automatiser la migration des projets existants.

Les principales missions seront :

  • Analyser l'architecture existante du Track Builder et identifier les éléments impactés par les évolutions de versions.
  • Concevoir et développer un framework générique de migration en C++, basé sur une architecture modulaire, des interfaces génériques et des design patterns adaptés.
  • Étudier et intégrer des mécanismes d'IA générative et de LLM pour analyser automatiquement les différences entre versions (code source, schémas XML/XSD, couches SIG, fichiers de configuration et templates).
  • Développer un moteur de validation automatique permettant de contrôler l'intégrité et la cohérence des projets après migration.
  • Étudier et mettre en œuvre des mécanismes de gestion des erreurs, de rollback et de sécurisation des migrations.
  • Participer à l'intégration du framework dans le processus de développement et le pipeline CI/CD du Track Builder.

Ce stage offre l'opportunité de travailler sur un sujet à forte dimension technique, mêlant génie logiciel, architecture C++, Intelligence Artificielle générative et automatisation, avec des applications concrètes dans le domaine ferroviaire.

Requirements

Nous recherchons un(e) étudiant(e) en dernière année d'école d'ingénieurs ou en Master 2 Informatique / Génie logiciel, préparant un diplôme de niveau Bac+5.

Compétences techniques requises :

  • Très bonne maîtrise du C++ et de la programmation orientée objet.
  • Bonnes connaissances en conception et architecture logicielle.
  • Maîtrise des algorithmes et des structures de données.
  • Utilisation des outils de gestion de versions (Git/SVN).
  • Connaissances en tests unitaires et qualité logicielle.

Compétences appréciées :

  • Framework Qt.
  • QGIS et systèmes d'information géographique (SIG).
  • Formats XML/XSD et bases de données GeoPackage/SQLite.
  • Python.
  • Outils et pratiques CI/CD.
  • Intelligence Artificielle générative, LLM et prompt engineering.
  • Analyse statique de code et conception de systèmes logiciels complexes.

Qualités attendues :

  • Esprit d'analyse et de synthèse.
  • Autonomie, rigueur et curiosité technique.
  • Capacité à proposer des solutions d'architecture et à prendre du recul sur des problématiques complexes.
  • Intérêt pour les nouvelles technologies et l'innovation.

Information importante : le stage est réservé aux candidats de nationalité française.

Une connaissance du domaine ferroviaire constitue un plus, mais n'est pas indispensable.

 

Benefits

data.title: Chargé F/H de coordination et de gestion de projet de recherche en mobilité éco-responsable et autonome

Missions

  • Assurer la coordination administrative du projet RITMEA ;

  • Assurer le pilotage administratif de l’ensemble des activités du consortium en liaison avec le coordinateur scientifique du projet.

Activités principales

  • Assurer le pilotage administratif et le suivi des engagements financiers du projet RITMEA (axe 3) ;

  • Participer aux réunions du projet ;

Selon expérience et financement

50 jours de congés, RTT comprise, par année universitaire

Compiègne

data.title: Executive Assistant
data.description:
This is Cradle

Proteins are the molecular machines of life, used for many therapeutic, diagnostic, chemical, agricultural and food applications. Designing and optimizing proteins takes a lot of expert knowledge and manual effort, through the use of custom computational and biological tools.

Machine learning is revolutionizing this space, by enabling high-fidelity protein models. At Cradle, we offer a software platform for AI-guided discovery and optimization of proteins, so that biologists can design proteins faster and at scale. We are already used by clients across biopharma, biotech, agri-tech, food-tech, and academia.

We're an experienced team of just under 100 people. We've built many successful products before and have enough funding for multiple years of runway. We are distributed across three offices in Amsterdam, Boston, and Zurich, alongside a few remote colleagues.

We offer our employees a very competitive salary, a generous equity stake in the company and a wide range of benefits and career progression opportunities.

The Role

As Executive Assistant at Cradle, you'll keep two of our founding executives moving. Between customer visits, investor meetings, hiring and travel across Amsterdam, Zurich and the US, there's a lot to keep track of, and your job is to make sure nothing gets dropped. You'll own their calendars, inboxes and travel, and take care of the personal admin that would otherwise eat into their time. This role suits someone who likes being trusted with the whole picture, professional and personal, and treats both with the same care.

Responsibilities

  • Run two calendars as one system: Protect focus time, balance competing priorities across time zones, and decide what deserves a meeting and what can be an email.

  • Own the inbox front line: Triage, draft and reply on their behalf to customers, investors, candidates and the team, so the important things surface and the rest gets handled.

  • Plan travel end to end: Customer visits, conferences and trips between Amsterdam, Zurich and the US, from flights and hotels to the meeting room and dinner booking on the other side.

  • Take care of personal and life admin: Appointments, household logistics, official paperwork, bills and renewals, handled so none of it lands on their desks.

  • Prepare every important meeting: Make sure briefs and context are ready beforehand, and follow up on decisions and action items afterwards.

  • Make recurring admin disappear: Automate repeated processes so they mostly run themselves.

Requirements

The best people we've hired didn't match a checklist. Below is a list of what matters most for this role. If you bring most of it and are curious about the rest, we'd love to hear from you:

  • 4+ years supporting senior executives, ideally more than one at a time

  • Sharp judgment about what's urgent, what can wait and what never needs to reach the exec

  • Clear, polished written English

  • You spot the next problem before anyone asks and fix it

  • Experience handling personal admin alongside the professional side, with the discretion that comes with it

  • Organised and dependable without needing a rigid structure; at a ~90-person company you'll often build the process yourself

  • At home in Google Workspace and quick to pick up new software tools

Nice to Haves

These aren't requirements, but they'd give you a head start:

  • German fluency would be ideal to make local appointments, paperwork and authorities much easier

  • Experience in a startup or scale-up environment

  • Familiarity with Swiss administrative procedures (permits, insurance, tax paperwork, relocations)

  • Experience with task tools like Todoist, Notion or Linear

Our commitment to inclusive hiring

Cradle evaluates all candidates based on merit, regardless of sex, gender, ethnicity, socio-economic background, or any other aspect of identity. We maintain zero tolerance for discrimination and actively encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

AI disclosure

Cradle uses an applicant tracking system that includes basic AI-assisted features which may generate scores or rankings based on how applications match a job description. These outputs are not used to make or meaningfully influence hiring decisions — all candidates are evaluated through a thorough, human-led review by our recruiting team.

A notice about recruitment scams

Please be aware that scammers are posing as us in order to get your personal details or money. We only communicate via @cradle.bio email addresses, we only make job offers after having met you in person at our office in Zurich or Amsterdam, and we never ask you to pay for anything during the interview process.

data.title: Marketing Operations
data.description:
About us:

Founded by former Google search engineers with PhDs in AI from ETH Zurich, DeepJudge helps legal teams unlock and apply the knowledge inside their organizations through world-class enterprise search and AI infrastructure – enabling them to automate workflows, build knowledge-powered applications, and turn institutional knowledge into a lasting advantage.

Every organization can license the same AI models, but no two organizations share the same institutional knowledge. Decades of experience, work product, and precedent are often fragmented across systems, underused, and inaccessible. DeepJudge makes this expertise instantly available and actionable – helping legal teams find the right information faster, surface relevant knowledge, and apply it where it matters most.

Our platform is trusted by many of the world’s leading law firms and legal teams, including Holland & Knight, Gunderson Dettmer, Cozen O’Connor, ArentFox Schiff, CMS Switzerland, Schoenherr, and others.

Headquartered in Switzerland with a growing team across North America and Europe, DeepJudge is shaping the future of how professional knowledge is discovered and applied.

At DeepJudge, we move with urgency, think rigorously, and work closely with our clients to build products that solve meaningful problems. If you want to help define how AI transforms professional knowledge work, we’d love to hear from you.

About the role:
We’re looking for a Marketing Operations Manager to build and scale the operational engine behind DeepJudge’s marketing and qualified pipeline growth.

This is a builder role for someone who can design, implement, and own the lifecycle, scoring, routing, campaign and attribution systems. You’ll act as a strategic and operational business partner to Content, Field, Demand Gen and Product Marketing, and work with Sales, RevOps and Partnerships to make sure every lead and target account reaches the right seller, and that we know which programs created the pipeline.

If you naturally think: “Which campaign actually created this opportunity, and why did it take three days to reach a rep?” …you’ll likely be a strong fit. You will play a key role in giving our growing sales team a reliable flow of qualified pipeline and in driving commercial success.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Lead and account lifecycle

    • Own the lead and account lifecycle from first touch to sales-qualified opportunity, including lifecycle stages, MQL/SQL definitions and SLAs

    • Design and maintain lead scoring, inbound routing and assignment rules as the marketing and sales team grows

    • Run the Marketing-to-Sales handoff with clear acceptance criteria and feedback loops

  • Campaign, event and partner marketing operations

    • Administer HubSpot Marketing Hub and its integrations with ad, event and enrichment tools

    • Operationalize field and growth marketing: event lead capture, ABM programs, nurture workflows and partner campaigns

    • Own campaign attribution and pipeline source reporting

  • AI, automation, and marketing innovation

    • Identify, test and roll out AI tools and automations that measurably improve marketing performance, scalability and efficiency.

    • Build workflows connecting intent signals, enrichment, CRM, landing pages and advertising platforms, to power ABM and personalized campaigns at scale, in partnership with Demand Generation.

    • Turn successful experiments into repeatable processes, partnering with our GTM Engineer on complex integrations and shared technical infrastructure.

    • Partner with Demand Generation to scale campaigns through AI-assisted segmentation, dynamic landing pages and targeted advertising.

    • Experiment with emerging GTM technologies and turn successful prototypes into repeatable marketing processes.

  • Attribution and performance

    • Own campaigns and marketing attribution frameworks and pipeline source reporting.

    • Build and maintain marketing funnel dashboard, in terms of volume, stage conversion, velocity and campaign ROI.

    • Analyze marketing funnel performance and identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency and campaign effectiveness.

  • Data quality and business partnership

    • Set and enforce marketing data standards: hygiene, enrichment, deduplication and consent management

    • Act as Operational business partner to Marketing, Sales and CSM, Partnership leadership

What success looks like in 12 months:

  • Every inbound lead and target account reaches the right owner within an agreed SLA

  • Marketing and Sales work from one shared set of lifecycle definitions and with a trusted MQL/SQL handoff

  • Field and Demand Gen spend measurably less time on admin because they can rely on an efficient system from lead to SQL

  • Leadership can see which campaigns, events and partners touched and created pipeline

  • Marketing data completeness and accuracy support leadership decision making

  • AI-powered workflows run in production across ABM and lifecycle marketing, with measurable gains in efficiency or performance

You're a great fit if you:

  • Have 4+ years in Marketing Operations or Demand Generation Operations in B2B SaaS, including time at a high-growth company

  • Have deep hands-on expertise in HubSpot Marketing Hub administration (Marketo or Pardot also considered)

  • Have a proven track record designing lead lifecycle, scoring and routing for a sales team that scaled

  • Have experience building campaign attribution and pipeline source reporting

  • Have hands-on experience building automations and enrichment workflows (e.g. Clay, Zapier/n8n, ZoomInfo/Apollo, intent data)

  • Bring an analytical mindset with comfort in funnel math and data quality work

  • Have excellent stakeholder management across GTM teams

What you can look forward to:

  • Owning the marketing operations engine that supports marketing and feeds a growing sales team

  • Helping shape how a category-defining AI company builds and scales its go-to-market engine from the ground up

  • Working directly with leadership and a modern, AI-native GTM stack

  • A competitive compensation and equity package that reflects the leverage and strategic importance of the role



At DeepJudge, we believe great teams are built on diverse perspectives and experiences. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to fostering an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can thrive. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer (Python, Telecom)
data.description:
Für einen Kunden suchen wir einen Senior Software Engineer mit fundiertem Python- und Telekommunikations-Know-how. Du entwickelst eine Plattform weiter, die die Bereitstellung und Inbetriebnahme von Telekommunikationsdiensten über mehrere Netzdomänen hinweg automatisiert. Als Stellvertretung des Technical Leads koordinierst du die technische Umsetzung im Team und begleitest Lösungen vom Architekturentscheid bis in den Betrieb.

  • Den Multi-Domain Service Orchestrator (MDSO) auf Basis von HPE Telco Service Orchestrator und Python-Microservices weiterentwickeln.

  • TM-Forum-basierte Servicemodelle, intent-basierte Orchestrierungslogik und wiederverwendbare Funktionen für Datennetze, Netzinventar, IP-Management, Mobilfunk inklusive FRMCS und Datacenter entwickeln.

  • Asynchrone Python-Services, REST APIs mit OpenAPI-Spezifikationen sowie ereignisgesteuerte Integrationen mit Kafka und TM Forum APIs implementieren.

  • Den Technical Lead vertreten, Architekturentscheidungen in technische Designs überführen und diese auf Teamebene verantworten und freigeben.

  • Engineering-Standards definieren, Code- und Design-Reviews durchführen, Engineers coachen und Lösungen externer Lieferanten und Systemintegratoren technisch beurteilen.

  • Automatisierte Tests entwickeln, an CI/CD-Pipelines mit Git, Tekton, Argo CD und OpenShift mitarbeiten und andere Telecom-Teams bei der Umsetzung von Automatisierungsvorhaben unterstützen.

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Software Engineering auf Senior-Level mit ausgezeichneten Python-Kenntnissen und fundierter Praxis mit asynchronem Python, FastAPI, Pydantic und pytest.

  • Fundierte Erfahrung mit REST und OpenAPI, verteilten Microservice-Architekturen, komplexen Systemintegrationen und ereignisgesteuerten Integrationen mit Kafka.

  • Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und im Betrieb containerisierter Services auf OpenShift oder Kubernetes sowie mit Git und CI/CD.

  • Erfahrung mit intent-basierter und modellgetriebener Service-Orchestrierung, sehr gute Kenntnisse der TM Forum APIs und ein sehr gutes Verständnis dafür, wie Produkte, Services und Ressourcen modelliert und zerlegt werden.

  • Nachgewiesene Erfahrung mit technischen Designs, Code- und Design-Reviews, Engineering-Standards und Mentoring sowie enge Zusammenarbeit mit System- oder Solution-Architekten.

  • Fähigkeit, technische Lösungen von Lieferanten und Systemintegratoren kritisch zu beurteilen und Feedback konstruktiv zu vermitteln. Ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten, Kommunikationsstärke und lösungsorientiertes Arbeiten.

  • Fundierte Erfahrung mit agilen Arbeitsweisen und SAFe.

  • Deutsch auf Niveau C1 und Englisch auf Niveau B2.

  • Praxis mit HPE Telco Service Orchestrator oder vergleichbaren Plattformen wie Cisco NSO oder Ciena Blue Planet. (von Vorteil)

  • Kenntnisse von TM Forum SID und ODA, Telecom-OSS-Architekturen und Multi-Vendor-Umgebungen. (von Vorteil)

  • Verständnis von IP, VLANs, VRFs, Layer 2/3, Routing und MPLS sowie Erfahrung mit Network Inventory oder IPAM. (von Vorteil)

  • Kenntnisse von YANG, NETCONF, RESTCONF oder gNMI. (von Vorteil)

  • Erfahrung mit Tekton, Argo CD, Helm, Ansible, API Management oder Java. (von Vorteil)

  • Bachelor- oder Masterabschluss in Informatik oder vergleichbare praktische Erfahrung. (von Vorteil)
