data.title: Customer Success Manager – Adoption & Accompagnement 80/100%
data.description:
Le go-live, c’est seulement le début.


Chez RogerHR, notre accompagnement ne s’arrête pas à la mise en production. Une fois la plateforme en place, il reste à aider nos clients à en tirer pleinement parti, au quotidien et sur le long terme. Leurs besoins évoluent, et Roger aussi : de nouvelles fonctionnalités sortent régulièrement, et chacune peut leur faire gagner du temps… à condition de savoir qu’elle existe et de savoir s’en servir.


En tant que Customer Success Manager orienté adoption, tu deviens l’interlocuteur clé de nos clients après le démarrage. Ton rôle a un impact direct sur le quotidien des équipes RH : moins de tâches manuelles, des processus plus fluides, et plus de temps pour ce qui compte vraiment, l’humain.


Ton objectif : que chaque client soit autonome, satisfait et qu’il tire toujours plus de valeur d’une plateforme qui ne cesse de s’enrichir.

Vos missions

Faire vivre la relation client

  • Garder un contact régulier et proactif avec chaque client et faire avec lui le point sur son utilisation de Roger

  • Prendre le pouls de la satisfaction et repérer les signaux faibles (baisse d’usage, frustrations, changement d’interlocuteur)

  • Construire une relation de confiance durable avec les équipes RH, la direction et les key users

Analyser et améliorer les usages

  • Comprendre comment chaque client utilise réellement Roger, avec le recul de l’utilisation au quotidien

  • Analyser ses processus RH pour repérer les irritants, les contournements et les tâches manuelles qui subsistent

  • Proposer des pistes d’amélioration concrètes : paramétrage, fonctionnalités inexploitées, automatisations

  • Challenger avec bienveillance les habitudes en place quand une meilleure façon de faire existe

  • Conseiller les clients sur les bonnes pratiques RH et la bonne application des règles (temps de travail, absences, vacances…) dans Roger

Valoriser le travail accompli

  • Aider les équipes RH à valoriser en interne le travail accompli avec Roger, auprès de leur direction comme de leurs collaborateurs

  • Construire avec elles un business case concret : temps gagné, processus simplifiés, fiabilité des données, retour sur investissement

Rendre les clients autonomes

  • Former les key users et les nouveaux arrivants côté client

  • Expliquer, réexpliquer et vulgariser, avec patience et pédagogie

  • Créer ou enrichir les ressources d’auto-formation (guides, tutoriels, bonnes pratiques) pour garantir des pratiques harmonieuses entre nos clients

Faire découvrir les nouveautés

  • Suivre de près les évolutions de Roger et savoir à quels clients chaque nouveauté sera utile

  • Présenter les nouvelles fonctionnalités et aider les clients à les intégrer dans leurs processus

  • Organiser des sessions de découverte (webinars, démos ciblées, ateliers)

Contribuer à la croissance

  • Identifier les besoins non couverts et les opportunités d’upsell (nouveaux modules, intégrations, nouveau périmètre)

  • Accompagner l’équipe commerciale sur les opportunités détectées

  • Contribuer à la fidélisation et au renouvellement des contrats

Être la voix RH chez Roger

  • Partager ton expertise RH avec l’équipe (Customer Success, produit, développement) pour que Roger colle au plus près de la réalité du terrain

  • Faire remonter les retours clients à l’équipe produit et éclairer les choix grâce à ta connaissance des pratiques et des règles RH

  • Aider tes collègues à monter en compétence sur les sujets RH

Ton profil

Tu viens des RH et tu veux avoir un réel impact sur le quotidien de tes pairs.
Tu as plusieurs années d’expérience en ressources humaines : gestionnaire RH, HR business partner, responsable RH, administrateur SIRH ou consultant RH. Tu connais de l’intérieur le quotidien des équipes RH : la saisie manuelle, les fichiers Excel, les règles complexes à appliquer et le manque de temps pour les sujets à valeur ajoutée. Aujourd’hui, tu as envie de mettre cette expérience au service d’autres professionnels RH pour les aider à mieux travailler.


Chez Roger, tu seras à la fois un(e) allié(e) pour nos clients, qui parle leur langage et comprend leurs enjeux, et la référence RH de notre équipe, qui nous aide à construire un produit toujours plus juste.

Compétences essentielles

Hard skills

  • Expertise RH : tu maîtrises les processus RH (absences, vacances, temps de travail, cycle de vie des collaborateurs…) et les règles qui les encadrent, notamment le droit du travail suisse

  • Analyse de processus : tu sais décortiquer un fonctionnement existant et proposer des améliorations concrètes

  • Sens du business : tu sais chiffrer la valeur d’une amélioration et repérer les opportunités, sans jamais forcer la vente

  • Aisance avec les outils digitaux : tu as déjà utilisé un SIRH ou d’autres outils SaaS et tu aimes ça

  • Gestion de projets : tu suis plusieurs clients en parallèle sans en perdre un de vue

  • Français et anglais courants (l’allemand est un plus)

Soft skills

  • Envie d’impact : améliorer concrètement le quotidien des équipes RH te motive

  • Patience et pédagogie : tu aimes transmettre et tu ne te lasses pas d’expliquer

  • Écoute active : tu poses les bonnes questions et tu entends aussi ce qui n’est pas dit

  • Excellent relationnel : tu crées facilement la confiance et tu entretiens la relation dans la durée

  • Proactivité : tu n’attends pas que le client t’appelle, tu vas vers lui

  • Esprit d’équipe : tu aimes partager ce que tu sais et faire grandir les autres

Les PLUS qui feront la différence

✓ Expérience dans le paramétrage ou l’administration d’un SIRH
✓ Participation à un projet de digitalisation RH ou de mise en place d’un outil
✓ Expérience de la formation d’utilisateurs ou de la conduite du changement
✓ Brevet fédéral de spécialiste RH ou formation équivalente
✓ Expérience en startup ou en scale-up

Avantages

Environnement de travail

  • Télétravail flexible (1 jour/semaine au bureau et déplacements réguliers chez nos clients en Suisse romande)

  • Équipement de qualité selon goûts / besoins du collaborateur (laptop, écrans, etc.)

  • Accès à tous les rabais Swibeco

Culture & évolution

  • Un impact direct sur le quotidien de nombreuses équipes RH

  • Autonomie et responsabilités dès le départ

  • Une équipe dynamique et bienveillante

  • Des opportunités d’évolution rapides

Tu veux simplifier la vie de tes collègues RH ? Envoie-nous ton CV et quelques lignes sur ce qui te motive.

Dufour provides sovereign, automated aerial logistics capabilities. Transitioning from a UAV developer into a defence-first network provider, we deliver complete, repeatable operating systems – combining automated aircraft fleets, control rooms, training, and support – to keep critical supplies moving when conventional infrastructure is disrupted.

The Role

We are looking for a creative and tech-savvy 3D Concept & Visualization Artist to bring our new aircraft designs to life through compelling photorealistic and concept renderings. Working closely with our communications team, you will visualize our upcoming aircraft platforms in real-world mission scenarios – while providing clean base renders that enable our team to generate fast variations using AI tools.

What You Will Do

  • Aircraft & Scenario Renderings: Create photorealistic and concept renderings of our new aircraft platforms operating across diverse environments and mission scenarios.

  • 3D Modeling & Scene Setup: Prepare, optimize, and texture existing CAD models, or build complementary concept assets, environments, and lighting setups from scratch.

  • AI-Ready Base Assets & Enablement: Deliver clean, structured base renders and transparent cutouts that enable our internal team to independently generate quick variations and new backgrounds using AI tools.

What You Bring

  • 3D & Rendering Tools: Solid experience in 3D modeling and rendering or real-time engines, such as Blender, Cinema 4D, Rhino, Unreal Engine, KeyShot, or Vizcom.

  • AI Workflows & Post-Production: Experience with AI-assisted visualization tools like Vizcom or ComfyUI and image editing – ideally knowing how to structure base renders for downstream AI workflows; basic 3D animation skills are a plus.

  • Eye for Realism & Design: Strong sense of lighting, scale, and industrial or aerospace aesthetics to translate complex hardware into compelling scenes.

  • High Flexibility & Reliability: Pragmatic and responsive – able to jump in on short notice when urgent requests arise and occasionally deliver polished visuals within tight timelines.

  • Background: Open to everyone with a strong portfolio – ideal as a flexible side job for design students as well as independent freelancers.

What We Oﬀer

  • High-Visibility Impact: Shape the visual identity of brand-new aircraft platforms and critical defence-logistics systems.

  • Uncomplicated Collaboration: Direct, fast feedback loops with a small, dedicated team – no bureaucratic overhead.

  • Flexibility: Fully remote setup with flexible working hours that fit easily around your studies or other freelance projects.

  • Fair Compensation: Competitive hourly rate or project-based flat fee.

data.title: High Voltage Electrical Engineer
data.description:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION

  • You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world.

  • You'll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals.

  • Do your life’s best work and enjoy the journey.

  • Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent.

YOUR IMPACT

In this role, you will tackle some of the most demanding high-voltage engineering challenges in the energy industry, developing electrical systems that enable next-generation plasma heating technologies. Your expertise will directly influence the performance, reliability, and safety of critical plant systems, shaping the electrical backbone of a first-of-a-kind fusion power plant. By advancing high-voltage power conversion, insulation, protection, and system integration, you will help transform cutting-edge scientific concepts into industrial-scale reality.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Lead the engineering and integration of high-voltage power systems supporting critical plant operations

  • Define high-voltage electrical architectures, simulate power conversion and selection of electrical components

  • Perform and review key electrical studies, including insulation coordination, transient overvoltage, short-circuit protection, grounding, and safety analyses

  • Develop strategies for high-voltage system monitoring, diagnostics, and condition assessment to improve reliability and maintainability

  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary engineering teams to ensure seamless integration of high-voltage systems with plant infrastructure and control systems

  • Oversee testing, commissioning, and validation activities for high-voltage equipment and subsystems

  • Build a safety culture that protects our people first and equipment second, from the dangers inherent in high voltage systems

WHO YOU ARE

  • You hold a University (Higher education) degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems Engineering, or a related field

  • You have experience designing, analyzing, or commissioning high-voltage electrical systems in industrial, utility, research, or energy applications

  • You enjoy solving complex engineering challenges and developing innovative solutions where established approaches may not yet exist

  • Experience in the design and application of insulation systems, electric field management, and creepage and clearance coordination is a plus

  • Familiarity with protection systems, interlocking philosophies, and functional safety concepts for high-energy electrical installations is a plus

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

  • Technical Screening (30 min)

  • Technical Panel (3x60 min)

At Proxima Fusion, our mission is bold: making limitless clean energy a reality. To get there, we need a high-performing, diverse team that brings different perspectives, challenges assumptions, and builds together with purpose. We know that diversity of thought and experience leads to better ideas, stronger execution, and a more resilient team. We don’t look at how you identify, what you look like, who you choose to worship or what ethnicity you are. We care about what you can bring to the table.

data.title: HTS Testing Engineer
data.description:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

TEAM & ROLE

  • Architect a breakthrough energy technology – Play a defining role in designing and integrating the systems that will power the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion plant, influencing decisions that shape the future of clean energy.

  • Solve some of the most complex engineering challenges in fusion – Work across magnet design, HTS technology, manufacturing, structural integration, and controls, turning cutting-edge science into real hardware

  • Move fast and build what matters – Join a highly ambitious, multidisciplinary team that combines cutting-edge simulation with hands-on engineering, turning bold ideas into real hardware on the path to commercial fusion.

WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION

  • Impact: Your work will directly shape the magnets that enable commercial fusion energy.

  • Ownership: As an early member of a growing team, you’ll help define how we test HTS at scale.

  • Development: Build specialist skills at the cutting edge of superconducting magnet technology.


    WHAT YOU WILL DO

1. Qualification at Scale

  • Test Planning: Define test strategies, sampling plans and pass/fail criteria for HTS tapes and cables, and help set up production testing at our Magnet Factory.

  • Measurement: Commission test systems and develop measurement processes that ensure reproducible, traceable measurements of critical current (Ic) and related properties, including the effects of manufacturing processes.

  • Data & Statistics: Help design our HTS test database, with traceability from supplier and reel through to cable, and turn results into statistical datasets for magnet modelling and design.

  • Supplier Selection: Compare supplier data with our own measurements and support decisions on which tapes to use in Alpha and future stellarators.

2. R&D

  • HTS Qualification: Run tape and cable qualification test campaigns, both in-house and at external facilities.

  • Analysis & Reporting: Compare results with models and give clear technical recommendations to the design, modelling and manufacturing teams.

  • Equipment Development: Support the development of new test equipment and methods with external partners.

3. Planning, Safety & Team

  • Planning: Plan test campaigns in line with tape deliveries and the Alpha build programme.

  • Technician Guidance: Write procedures and guide the technicians who run routine tests.

  • Safety: Ensure safe work with cryogens, high currents and high magnetic fields.

  • Quality: Ensure results are traceable, well documented and reproducible.

WHO YOU ARE

An engineer or scientist who enjoys careful, hands-on experimental work as much as planning how we test at scale.

  • You hold an MSc or PhD in Physics, Materials Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.

  • You have hands-on experience characterising materials or devices, and are comfortable designing experiments.

  • You speak fluent English.

  • You have strong data analysis skills and a solid grasp of measurement uncertainty and statistics.

  • You are happy to travel for test campaigns at external facilities, including internationally.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience with superconductors, cryogenics or high magnetic fields.

  • Experience with quality control or production testing at scale.

  • Experience designing cryogenic or automated test equipment.

  • Familiarity with HTS tape manufacturing processes and the supplier landscape.

  • German language skills.

This role will initially be based in our Zurich office. As the project develops, the position may move to Germany. If that happens, we’ll give you at least six months’ notice and support you through the move.

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

  • Technical Screening (30 min)

  • Technical Panel (3x60 min)

At Proxima Fusion, our mission is bold: making limitless clean energy a reality. To get there, we need a high-performing, diverse team that brings different perspectives, challenges assumptions, and builds together with purpose. We know that diversity of thought and experience leads to better ideas, stronger execution, and a more resilient team. We don’t look at how you identify, what you look like, who you choose to worship or what ethnicity you are. We care about what you can bring to the table.

Still with us? Great — here's why this role is worth your attention.

Who we are

We're Jobtome (https://weare.jobtome.com/) — an HR Tech company building the modern web applications that companies use to run complex hiring and recruitment workflows at scale.

Our products are highly interactive, data-driven, and built for real-world usage — not demos. We work with a strong product mindset, short feedback loops, and a pragmatic engineering culture: quality, ownership, and code we're still proud of a year from now.

The role

You'll join our engineering team as a Senior Go Backend Developer and take real ownership of critical backend systems and services — not ticket-pushing, actual ownership.

You'll design, build, and evolve the backend services that power our products, weigh in on architectural decisions, improve system reliability, and help shape how backend engineering is done across the company.

This is a hands-on senior role: you'll write production Go every day and be deeply involved in technical decisions that have real impact.


Quick reminder before the details

5+ years of production Go experience — required Based in a European timezone (UTC−1 to UTC+3)

What you'll do

  • Design, build, and maintain backend services written in Go

Our stack

Go sits at the center of everything. Around it, you'll work with (and should be comfortable with):

  • BigQuery and other NoSQL databases

Nice to have:

What "senior" means to us

Titles vary — here's what we actually mean. A senior engineer at Jobtome can:

  • Make informed architectural decisions and explain the trade-offs

  • Write clean, maintainable, well-structured code

  • Spot problems early and propose solutions

  • Communicate clearly with technical and non-technical people alike

How we work

Senior Security Engineer, AI & Application Security
data.description:
We are looking for a seasoned Senior Security Engineer, focused on AI & Application Security, to join our Platform team in Amsterdam. Working in a bootstrapped and profitable scaleup, you'll take a proactive, hands-on, senior role securing our agentic AI products, owning an emerging and fast-growing area of security engineering, the risks that come specifically from building with LLMs and autonomous agents, while helping raise the bar on our broader application security practices.

Why DataSnipper?

The hardest AI problems aren't about getting an answer fast. They're about getting one people can trust.

We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable.

At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals. By making evidence easier to trace and verify, we help them focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important.

For our product and engineering team, this is where things get exciting. In audit, a plausible answer isn't good enough. Every output has to be explainable and traceable back to its source. We've just launched a brand new agentic platform, Alwin by DataSnipper. AI agents running in the cloud across hundreds of documents at once, reasoning across PDF, Word and Excel, with a full audit trail behind every step. There are lots of greenfield problems ahead, and real room to shape what we build and how we build it.

And we build at scale. More than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on DataSnipper, including Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. In 2025 alone, the DataSnipper platform delivered more than $1.4 billion in productivity savings to is customers. Backed by a $100 million Series B led by Index Ventures, at a $1 billion valuation, and as proud members of 1% for the Planet, we care about how we grow, not just how fast.

If you want to build AI that professionals trust with work that really matters, this is your chance to help shape the future of audit and finance and do the best work of your career along the way.



What You Will Do

  • Own AI-specific security as a discipline at DataSnipper: identify, assess, and mitigate the risks unique to LLM-based and agentic systems across our products and platform.

  • Translate security policies and risk requirements into concrete technical controls, standards, and guardrails, in partnership with Legal and technical teams.

  • Build a proactive AI security practice grounded in frameworks such as the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, the broader OWASP GenAI Security Project (including agentic security), MITRE ATLAS, and the NIST AI Risk Management Framework, and adapt them to how we build.

  • Threat model our agentic features and pipelines, covering prompt injection, sensitive information disclosure, data and model poisoning, insecure output handling, excessive agency, supply-chain risk, and unsafe tool and API use.

  • Red team our AI systems, probing models, prompts, agents, and integrations for weaknesses before attackers do, and turn findings into concrete fixes and guardrails.

  • Design and help implement guardrails, input/output validation, sandboxing, least-privilege tool access, and monitoring for AI and agent behavior.

  • Embed security into how we build AI, shifting security left through secure-by-design guidance, secure SDLC practices, and design and code reviews for AI features.

  • Partner with product and engineering teams to make secure AI the default, providing patterns, tooling, and guidance rather than after-the-fact gatekeeping.

  • Strengthen our overall security engineering posture alongside the SRE team, contributing to our SOC 2 and compliance efforts (e.g. via Vanta), CI/CD security gates, and the principle that vulnerable code cannot get deployed.

  • Own our vulnerability management process: identify and prioritize vulnerabilities based on risk, drive remediation across engineering and platform teams, track findings to closure, and fix recurring findings at the root.

  • Strengthen identity and access management, secrets management, and encryption across our products and platform, including the credentials and access that agents and AI integrations depend on.

  • Establish detection, logging, and incident response practices for AI-specific threats, and help the team respond when they occur.

  • Stay ahead of a rapidly evolving threat landscape and continuously raise the bar for how we secure AI.

  • Promote secure development practices through developer guidance and trainings, awareness initiatives, and collaboration with engineering teams.

What You Bring

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in security engineering, application security, or a closely related field, with a track record of owning security work end to end in production.

  • Strong grounding in application and cloud security fundamentals: threat modeling, secure design, common vulnerability classes, and secure SDLC practices.

  • Hands-on experience with SAST, DAST, SCA, API Security, Threat Modeling and Vulnerability Management.

  • Hands-on experience with identity and access management, secrets management, and encryption implementations.

  • Demonstrated interest and hands-on experience in AI/LLM security, whether through professional work, research, red teaming, CTFs, or personal projects, and familiarity with frameworks like the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications or MITRE ATLAS.

  • Solid understanding of how LLM-based and agentic systems work in practice, including prompts, tool/function calling, retrieval, and agent orchestration, and where they break.

  • Proficiency in a scripting or programming language (Python preferred) to build tooling, automate checks, and prototype mitigations.

  • Experience securing cloud-native systems, ideally on Azure, including CI/CD pipelines (e.g. GitHub) and infrastructure-as-code.

  • A proactive, builder mindset; you prevent problems by shipping guardrails and enabling teams, not just by finding issues.

  • Strong communication skills; able to explain AI-specific risks and tradeoffs to engineers, product managers, and leadership.

  • Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to thrive in a fast-moving scale-up, set technical direction, influence without authority, and mentor other engineers while defining a practice that doesn't yet have a playbook.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience red teaming or pentesting AI/LLM systems.

  • Familiarity with the OWASP GenAI Security Project's agentic security work and emerging standards for securing autonomous agents.

  • Experience with AI security tooling such as guardrail frameworks, LLM firewalls, prompt-injection scanners, or AI red-teaming tools.

  • Experience implementing security controls in production agentic systems, including sandboxing, least-privilege tool access, and runtime monitoring.

  • Familiarity with compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001) and tools like Vanta.

  • Experience with observability and monitoring tooling (e.g. Grafana).

  • Relevant security certifications (e.g. OSCP, GIAC, or AI-security-specific credentials).

  • Experience in fintech, audit technology, or other regulated, trust-sensitive domains.

  • Familiarity with responsible AI, model governance, or AI safety concepts.

What We Offer:

  • Be part of one of the fastest-growing, profitable unicorn scale-ups in the Netherlands with a global impact

  • Equity (Stock Appreciation Rights) to share the company's success and growth

  • Pension plan with a 6% contribution on top of your base salary

Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

The Role

We're looking for a Senior Revenue Operations Manager to join our Revenue Operations team and act as a broad, senior partner to our revenue organisation. You'll run the complex analysis and modelling behind target setting and annual planning for the entire commercial organisation. You will also help the Director set and execute the revenue analytics strategy, and run the insights that shape how revenue leadership sees the business. As you ramp up, you will take on growing ownership of the forecasting cadence alongside the Director of Revenue Operations.

We are looking for someone with very strong analytical and modelling skills, which are the foundation of the role, especially in your first two quarters. Just as important, we want someone who is commercially minded and keen to grow into a generalist role, broadening from there into revenue insights and forecasting.


What You’ll Do

  • First 90 days: Scope the revenue analytics strategy and build the core dashboards.

  • First 180 days: Lead the analysis for the annual planning and target-setting cycle, and automate the core of revenue reporting and insights with AI tooling.

  • First 12 months: Take on co-ownership of the forecasting cadence with the Director of Revenue Operations.

 

What Will You Be Doing?

Run Complex Modelling & Analysis

  • Run complex analysis and modelling to support target setting and the annual planning process for the entire commercial organisation, made up of around 600 commercial roles across SDRs, AEs and Account Managers.

  • Build and maintain the models behind target setting: capacity, quota and productivity assumptions, and territory and segment allocation.

  • Frame the key planning questions, choose the method, pressure-test scenarios and sensitivities, and deliver clear recommendations to revenue leadership, explaining the trade-offs in plain language.

  • Work as the senior analytical partner to the other analyst on the team: stay hands-on in the models while setting the quality bar and documentation standards, so each planning cycle is repeatable and auditable.

Build the Revenue Analytics Strategy

  • Partner with the Director of Revenue Operations to define the revenue analytics strategy: what we need to build across Salesforce and Looker, and in what order.

  • Map the current reporting landscape — what exists, what's trusted, what's duplicated or out of date — and use that map to shape the build plan.

  • Own execution of that plan: build and maintain the core dashboards and reports that revenue leadership and the wider commercial organisation rely on.

  • Launch and run a recurring insights digest for revenue leaders, turning dashboards and data into a clear narrative — what changed, why it matters, what to do about it.

  • Bring a point of view on what's worth building versus what's noise, and be willing to push back on requests that don't earn their keep.

Grow Into Forecasting

  • Co-run the forecasting cadence with sales leaders and the Director of Revenue Operations — forecast calls, pipeline reviews, and accuracy tracking.

  • Build and refine forecasting models based on pipeline, productivity, and historical conversion.

  • Conduct strategic analyses to determine forecasting trends and identify opportunities for process improvement.


What You’ll Bring

  • Strong experience in Revenue or Sales Operations, preferably in a SaaS or technology company operating at a global or European level.

  • Advanced modelling and scenario analysis skills (spreadsheets and SQL), ideally with experience in target setting, capacity planning or annual planning for a large commercial organisation.

  • Solid Salesforce reporting skills and working fluency in a BI tool (Looker or equivalent), with a practical, business-first approach to data.

  • Commercial judgement and exposure to quota-carrying teams such as Account Executives, plus a generalist mindset: as comfortable building a dashboard as a planning model or running a forecasting call.

  • The ability to influence sales leadership and revenue executives, and to own ambiguous problems end to end, from framing the question to landing the recommendation.

  • Excellent written communication, since the insights digest is a core, ongoing deliverable of this role.

  • Hands-on experience using AI tools to automate analysis and reporting, or a clear appetite to build that skill quickly.


What We Offer

  • 25 days of annual leave to rest and recharge, plus all public holidays.

  • An optional pension scheme to support your long-term financial wellbeing.

  • A tax-efficient bike leasing scheme through Lease a Bike, for your commute or personal use.

  • Reimbursed commuting costs if you live more than 10km away from the office.

  • Competitive compensation paired with equity in Perk.

  • Unforgettable team experiences, including our annual summer party.

  • Comprehensive wellbeing support through Spring Health, offering fast access to 12 therapy and 12 coaching sessions for you and your loved ones.

  • Focus on your family with 12-16 weeks’ paid parental leave

  • 16 paid volunteer hours each year to give back to causes you care about.

  • Up to 20 “Work From Anywhere” days annually to explore the world while staying connected.

  • A fully paid four-week sabbatical after five years with Perk.

  • Relocation support to help you move seamlessly into one of our hubs.

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

data.description:
About Nivoda

Nivoda is the operating system for the global jewellery industry. Our marketplace connects jewellers with suppliers of diamonds, gemstones, melee and finished jewellery in 70+ countries, with more than $300M in annual transactions and a $350B industry still waiting to be modernised. We are scaling fast, and we are only getting started.

Our Mission

For decades, the diamond trade has been slow, opaque and inefficient: hard to find stock, hard to trust prices, hard to know when anything will arrive. Nivoda exists to change that. We give businesses of every size, in every location, the same access to inventory, the same transparent pricing and the same reliable delivery as the biggest players in the industry.

The Fulfilment & Express Team

The Fulfilment & Express team is where Nivoda's promise to buyers is kept. We own how an order travels from supplier to jeweller: the delivery date we promise, the hubs that hold and check stock, the carriers that move it, and the returns and quality checks that protect every purchase. We are a remote-first team of product, engineering, design and QA who work closely with Operations, Customer Support, Sales and Supplier Experience. We are low on hierarchy and high on ownership, and we like solving problems where software meets the physical world.

About the Role

As our Senior Product Manager for Fulfilment & Express, you will own how Nivoda orders get from supplier to jeweller: accurately promised, reliably tracked and delivered fast. You will set the strategy and roadmap for a complex, operationally heavy product area that spans diamonds, gemstones, melee and finished jewellery, with physical hubs, carriers and suppliers behind every screen. Your work decides whether a jeweller trusts Nivoda with their next order, so this is a role with real commercial impact and plenty of room to lead.

What would YOU be doing?

  • Setting the fulfilment strategy for the next 2 to 4 quarters, making trade-offs explicit, including what we are choosing not to do and why

  • Owning the roadmap and the numbers: running quarterly planning, sizing opportunities and setting targets for delivery-as-promised, delivery date accuracy and delivery speed

  • Making our Promised Delivery Dates trustworthy by rolling out SLA-based, dynamic delivery dates across every category and route, and shaping how they are used for delay communications and, in time, shown to buyers

  • Scaling Express, our hub-based fast-delivery offer, including hub workflows (receiving, inventory and RFID put/pick, QC and dispatch), ready-to-wear jewellery, consignment flows and speed options such as same-day pickup

  • Owning jewellery returns and on-platform QC, from the manufacturer through to the hub, including hallmarking and consignment returns to suppliers

  • Improving the delivery experience through carrier and rate/transit integrations, consolidation, last-mile cost and efficiency, and clear order visibility for buyers

  • Translating hub operations, carrier behaviour, customs and supplier handling into clear product requirements, designing for the exceptions as much as the happy path

  • Turning support tickets, delay breaches, supplier performance data and customer feedback into prioritised problems, then deciding what to build, buy or fix operationally

  • Partnering daily with Engineering and Design, and closely with Operations, Customer Support, Account Management, Sales, Supplier Experience and Fintech so delivery, credit and payments feel like one journey for the buyer

  • Writing sharp PRDs and decision records, and reporting progress openly through our weekly updates

  • Mentoring other product managers and designers on working in operationally complex domains

What do we need from YOU?

  • 5 to 8 years in product management, including experience owning a complex product area end to end

  • Experience in fulfilment, logistics, supply chain or other operations-heavy products. You are comfortable where software meets warehouses, carriers, SLAs and customs

  • Strong systems thinking: you can map a multi-party process, find where promises break, and design for failure modes, delays and edge cases

  • Data fluency: you define the right metrics, query and interrogate data yourself (Snowflake, Mixpanel or similar) and use it to decide what to build next

  • Sound prioritisation and commercial judgement: you weigh impact, effort and risk honestly, say no clearly, and can explain the return on a fulfilment investment to leadership

  • Excellent cross-functional leadership: you build trust with engineers, operators and commercial teams, and influence without authority across time zones

  • Clear written communication: concise PRDs, roadmaps and updates that make decisions easy

  • Customer and operator empathy, and high agency: you spend time with jewellers, support teams and hub operators, you take ownership, and you follow things through to the outcome

Nice to have

  • Jewellery, diamond or luxury goods experience

  • Marketplace or B2B commerce experience, ideally two-sided with supply and demand constraints

  • Experience with carrier or shipping APIs, rate and transit tools, 3PL integrations, inventory systems or RFID

  • Experience building predictive or SLA-based estimates, such as delivery dates or ETAs

  • Experience with cross-border shipping, customs, duties or compliance (for example hallmarking and HS codes)


Our culture and what we offer

Nivoda is collaborative, high-growth and built on empowerment. You will have real ownership from day one, a team that wants you to succeed, and the chance to keep learning as the company scales. We are remote-first with flexible hours, and we trust you to do your best work your way.


Our current benefits

  • ⏰ Flexible working hours and a vibrant company culture

  • 🏡 Remote work

  • 🩺 Private health insurance

  • 📚 Opportunities for growth and learning

  • 💳 Flexible compensation card (meals, transport, childcare)

  • 🌴 Unlimited holiday allowance

  • 🚀 The chance to join during an exponential expansion phase


Equal opportunity

Nivoda is committed to building a diverse and inclusive team, and we welcome applications from everyone. Even if you do not meet 100% of our musts, do not let it stop you. If this role excites you, we would love to hear from you.

Compensation: $180K – $225K • Offers Equity

data.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
data.description:
Legal AI is zo goed als de kennis erachter, en aan die kennis bouwen we bij Lefebvre Sdu al 200 jaar. Dag in, dag uit. Wet voor wet. Woord voor woord. Dat doen we zo zorgvuldig dat andere legal AI-tools op onze data en software draaien. Vanuit ons Nederlandse kantoor bouwen we daarnaast voor Lefebvre Group, de Europese leider in juridische en fiscale kennis, ons eigen platform: GenIA-L, dat in Europa inmiddels goed is voor meer dan 100 miljoen euro ARR. Ruim 75.000 professionals werken er dagelijks mee, en we bouwen het op de standaard die hun vak vraagt. We zoeken een Senior DevOps Engineer die zorgt dat alles wat we bouwen veilig en soepel live gaat.

HOE JIJ ONS VERDER BRENGT

GenIA-L schuift steeds verder het dagelijkse werk van juristen en fiscalisten in, en dat vraagt om een platform dat soepel meebeweegt. Onze developers willen snel bouwen en veilig live gaan, zonder uren kwijt te zijn aan pipelines en repository-setup. Daar zorg jij voor. Onze infrastructuur draait op AWS, met Kubernetes via EKS, Terraform en Helm, en onze CI/CD loopt via GitHub Actions. In die pipelines borg jij bij elke release de secure coding-eisen van ISO 27001, van SAST en security scanning tot code quality checks en de OWASP Top 10. Nu ligt DevOps nog bij een extern team van 4 engineers. Binnen een jaar willen we die kennis volledig zelf in huis hebben, en daarin speel jij een hoofdrol. Je wordt het eerste aanspreekpunt voor de developers in Product & Technology, brengt structuur in hoe het team werkt en bouwt mee aan de volgende stappen, zoals de overstap van Helm naar ArgoCD. Je weet dat het gelukt is als de andere teams merkbaar minder tijd kwijt zijn aan hun deployments, de infrastructuur gezond is en je precies ziet wat er gebeurt. En als DevOps voelt als een vanzelfsprekend onderdeel van Product & Technology. De stack staat en de ambitie is helder. Wat nu nog ontbreekt, is het team dat dit zelf gaat dragen, en dat bouw jij mee op.


DIT ZOEKEN WIJ

Je bent een DevOps engineer die het liefst dicht bij de developers zit. Je bouwt een platform waar anderen zelf mee verder kunnen, vindt het vanzelfsprekend dat security in elke pipeline is ingebouwd en brengt graag rust en overzicht in een omgeving die in beweging is.
Je hebt minimaal 3 jaar hands-on ervaring met Kubernetes, idealiter met AWS EKS.

  • Je hebt veel gewerkt met AWS en Infrastructure as Code.

  • CI/CD en containers zijn een vertrouwd onderdeel van je werk.

  • Je zorgt voor duidelijkheid in technische processen en afspraken.

  • Ervaring met het bouwen en doorontwikkelen van een softwareproduct is een pré.

HIER TEKEN JE VOOR

Je rapporteert aan onze Lead Backend Engineer en bent de vaste sparringpartner van de developers in Product & Technology. Je krijgt veel vertrouwen, eigenaarschap en vrijheid, dus zie je iets wat beter moet, dan pak je het hier meestal gewoon zelf op. Daarbij is er ruimte voor een goede balans tussen werk en privé. Onze doorgroeipaden zijn nog in ontwikkeling, en omdat we tracks verwachten richting lead DevOps, principal engineering en engineering management, ben jij er vroeg bij.

  • Goed basissalaris en een standaard werkweek van 36 uur.

  • Een eindejaarsuitkering van 4% van jouw bruto jaarsalaris en een variabele winstdeling die kan oplopen tot 6% van jouw bruto jaarsalaris.

  • 23 vakantiedagen en een persoonlijk keuzebudget van 12%, waarvan 8% vakantiegeld en 4% vrij besteedbaar voor bijvoorbeeld extra vakantiedagen.

  • Een goede pensioenregeling via PGB, inclusief aanvullende partnerverzekering.

  • Een reiskostenvergoeding van €0,25 per kilometer of een OV-vergoeding, en we bieden een aantrekkelijke fietsregeling. Voor medewerkers met een reisafstand van minder dan 10 km of meer dan 60 km hebben we een aangepaste regeling.

  • Hybride werken: 2 dagen per week op kantoor in Den Haag, op dinsdag en donderdag.

  • Ruimte om te groeien. In je vak, in je rol, in de organisatie.

MEER WETEN?
Wij vertellen je graag alles over het team en de rol. Stuur jouw cv en je hoort binnen 2 werkdagen van ons. Eerst nog wat vragen? App of bel Nadine op 0628556265.

Een referentiecheck en een VOG horen bij het selectieproces.

kunnen presenteren. Vervolgens vertaal je deze ideeën naar concrete videoconcepten en ga je

zelfstandig aan de slag met de uitvoering.

Denk bijvoorbeeld aan:

• Productvideo’s: laat zien hoe onze producten in de praktijk worden gebruikt en welke

mogelijkheden ze bieden.

• Softwaredemo’s en screen recordings: maak korte, duidelijke video’s waarin je

functionaliteiten en toepassingen van onze software laat zien.

• Customer stories: breng in beeld hoe onderzoekers onze oplossingen gebruiken en welke

waarde ze toevoegen aan hun onderzoek.

• Animaties en motion graphics: gebruik animatie om complexe technologie, processen of

functionaliteiten eenvoudig uit te leggen.

• Combinaties van bestaand en nieuw beeldmateriaal: ontwikkel creatieve manieren om

bestaande content te vernieuwen en aan te vullen met nieuwe beelden.

Wat ga je doen?

Je krijgt de ruimte om het volledige creatieve proces te doorlopen, van eerste idee tot

eindproduct.

• Je inventariseert samen met het E-commerce team welke videocontent nodig is en waar de

grootste kansen liggen.

• Je ontwikkelt creatieve concepten, storyboards en een praktische contentplanning.

• Je organiseert en maakt nieuwe video-opnames, zowel van producten als van software in

gebruik.

• Je maakt screen recordings, animaties en motion graphics waar dit de boodschap versterkt.

• Je monteert en bewerkt het materiaal tot professionele video’s die passen bij onze nieuwe

huisstijl.

• Je zorgt ervoor dat de video’s geschikt zijn voor gebruik op onze website, productpagina’s en

andere digitale kanalen.

Wat willen we bereiken?

Aan het einde van de stage willen we beschikken over een vernieuwde collectie videocontent

die:

• Onze producten en software duidelijk en aantrekkelijk presenteert.

• Websitebezoekers helpt om sneller te begrijpen wat onze oplossingen doen en hoe ze worden

gebruikt.

• Een moderne, consistente uitstraling heeft die aansluit bij onze nieuwe website en huisstijl.

• Op verschillende plekken binnen onze digitale klantreis kan worden ingezet.

Naast concrete video’s werk je aan een herkenbare visuele stijl en aanpak, zodat we ook in de

toekomst op een consistente manier nieuwe videocontent kunnen ontwikkelen.

Wat bieden wij?

• Een creatieve stage met veel ruimte voor eigen ideeën en initiatief.

• De mogelijkheid om een project van concept tot eindproduct zelfstandig vorm te geven.

• Samenwerking met een enthousiast E-commerce team en verschillende productspecialisten.

• Een internationale en innovatieve werkomgeving.

• Concrete eindproducten die daadwerkelijk worden gebruikt op onze website en digitale

kanalen.

• Een mooie kans om je portfolio uit te breiden met uiteenlopende videoproducties, animaties

en softwaredemo’s.

Het eindresultaat

Je levert niet alleen een aantal professionele video’s op, maar helpt Noldus ook om een nieuwe

standaard neer te zetten voor hoe we onze producten en technologie visueel presenteren.

Jouw creativiteit maakt onze innovaties zichtbaar!


Wie zoeken wij?

We zoeken een creatieve, enthousiaste student die het leuk vindt om ideeën om te zetten in

professioneel beeldmateriaal. Je volgt bijvoorbeeld een hbo-opleiding in de richting van Creative

Business, Communication & Multimedia Design (CMD), Audiovisuele Media of een vergelijkbare

creatieve opleiding.

Je herkent jezelf in het volgende:

• Je hebt affiniteit met videoproductie, editing en visuele storytelling.

• Je kunt werken met tools zoals Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve of

vergelijkbare software.

• Je vindt het leuk om zowel te filmen als digitaal beeldmateriaal te creëren.

• Je kunt zelfstandig werken, maar zoekt ook actief de samenwerking op.

• Je bent creatief, neemt initiatief en denkt graag mee over hoe iets beter of aantrekkelijker

kan.

• Je vindt het interessant om complexe software of technologie op een toegankelijke manier uit

te leggen.

Ervaring met animatie of motion graphics is een pluspunt.

data.title: Business Development Manager, Integrator Partners - BENELUX
data.description:
Business Development Manager, Integrator Partners - BENELUX

Location: Netherlands – regular travel within BENELUX

Start date: Q1 2027

Compensation: €65K - €85K base annually (depending on experience and location) +OTE

Employment type: Full-time

About DTACT

DTACT (Data Transform Act) is a data technology company that helps organizations transform complex information into clear, actionable insights. Founded in 2016, we work with government agencies and enterprises across Europe to solve critical data challenges and support better decision-making in areas such as cybersecurity, defense, intelligence, public safety, and critical infrastructure. Built on deep expertise in these domains, we develop innovative solutions that help organizations gain greater visibility, understanding, and control over their data.

As a fully remote and internationally distributed company, we combine technical excellence with a collaborative and adaptable way of working. Our mission is simple: to help organizations turn information into action, enabling faster, smarter decisions when they matter most.

The Role

We're looking for a Business Development Manager (BDM) to make their mark in a brand-new role, with the rare chance to build a function rather than inherit one. As DTACT’s first BDM, you’ll grow our business across the Netherlands, Belgium and Luxembourg through system integrators and other integrator partners, shaping how the function is designed and scaled. You’ll be the primary commercial contact for a portfolio of partners, building relationships, agreeing joint business plans and turning partner activity into a steady flow of qualified pipeline and closed deals. Reporting to the Head of Sales BENELUX & South, you’ll work closely with Customer Experience, Product and Pre-sales to make every joint deal a success, with plenty of room to run your own agenda.

We’re looking for an enterprising, resourceful self-starter who treats every result as their own and flourishes with real independence. You’re a relationship builder with strong commercial drive who understands how integrators make money and how their sales and delivery teams work. You earn trust quickly with partner leaders and technical teams alike, you’re comfortable working across cultures and languages in BENELUX, and you pair a collaborative attitude with the discipline to hit your number. If you’d rather build something than step into something, we’d love to hear from you.

What you'll do

  • Own the commercial relationship with a portfolio of BENELUX integrator partners and be their first point of contact at DTACT.

  • Build and execute joint business plans with clear targets for pipeline, revenue, enablement and customer wins.

  • Identify, qualify and recruit new integrator partners that fit DTACT's market and strategy.

  • Own and accurately forecast the partner-sourced and partner-influenced revenue for your portfolio.

  • Co-sell with partners: join customer meetings, support proposals, build joint pipeline and drive complex deals to close, applying deal registration, pricing and margin rules consistently.

  • Make sure partner teams are trained, certified and confident; run regular business reviews; and work with Customer Experience on joint customer delivery.

  • Keep the CRM accurate, report on pipeline and partner performance, and bring partner feedback to Product, Engineering and Marketing.

What you'll bring

  • 5+ years of B2B sales or account management in IT, software or cybersecurity, focused on channel, partner or integrator sales.

  • A proven track record of meeting revenue targets through partners and building joint business plans.

  • An existing network or strong knowledge of system integrators and IT partners in BENELUX.

  • Enough technical understanding to hold credible conversations with partner engineers.

  • Strong communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.

  • Proactive, hands on approach. Does not need close supervision.

  • Professional English and Dutch; German is a strong plus.

  • Nice to have: experience in cybersecurity, AI or data; building partner programs; or public-sector and tender sales.

What's in for you

  • Competitive compensation and equity participation, including an Employee Stock Option Plan (ESOP), allowing you to share in DTACT's long-term success.

  • Remote-first flexibility, with the opportunity to work from anywhere within compatible time zones and a schedule that supports both collaboration and personal needs.

  • A trust-based culture built around asynchronous communication, empowering people to work independently while staying connected and aligned across teams.

  • Generous time off, including vacation days and local public holidays to help you rest, recharge, and maintain a healthy work-life balance.

  • Home office support, including high-quality equipment and a budget to create a productive and comfortable workspace.

  • An international and diverse team, where English is our company language and collaboration spans multiple countries, backgrounds, and perspectives.

  • High-impact work: DTACT helps organizations in and outside the government with mitigating their vulnerabilities and providing alerts to incoming threats.

We believe diverse teams build better solutions.

DTACT welcomes applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of background or identity. We hire based on skills, experience, and potential, and encourage everyone who meets the role requirements to apply.

Please note: Visa sponsorship is not available for this role. Candidates must be authorized to work in their country of residence.

data.title: Casino Proposition Executive
data.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Join our Commercial team in the Netherlands and help shape the casino experience on two of the Dutch market's most recognised brands: BetMGM.nl and LeoVegas.nl. Reporting to the Senior Commercial Manager and working alongside our CRM and Sports Proposition colleagues, you will make sure our casino offering stays relevant, well presented and commercially effective every day, with game content, casino pages and promotions that match what Dutch players want, all within the Dutch regulatory framework.

You will own the casino sections of both websites day to day, run the game launch programme and plan promotions together with CRM, while working closely with our central Product, Website, Data and Compliance teams. It is a hands-on role with real commercial impact in one of Europe's most dynamic regulated markets, and plenty of room to bring your own ideas. The role is based in our Amsterdam office on a hybrid basis, with three days a week in the office.



YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR:

  • Monitor and analyse game performance, and recommend changes to the casino portfolio based on player demand and market trends

  • Maintain the casino sections of BetMGM.nl and LeoVegas.nl, including game placement, visibility and page content

  • Work with the central Product and Website teams to keep the game catalogue accurate, visible and relevant

  • Identify new content opportunities and manage the game launch programme, coordinating with CRM, Product and Website teams

  • Plan and execute casino promotions with the CRM team to drive player engagement, retention and lifetime value

  • Analyse campaign results and help refine bonus structures and reward mechanics

  • Track competitors, new releases and player trends, and report on product and promotion performance

  • Ensure all casino propositions and communications comply with Dutch regulation and responsible gaming standards, and stay consistent across both brands

OUR SUCCESSFUL CANDIDATE WILL HAVE THE FOLLOWING:



ESSENTIAL SKILLS

  • Fluent Dutch and English, both written and spoken (Dutch is a must for this role)

  • Proven experience in a casino operations, product or marketing role within iGaming (operator or supplier)

  • Strong knowledge of casino game types, player behaviour, bonus structures and reward mechanics, and what drives game performance

  • Confident using performance dashboards and data reports to support decisions

  • Knowledge of Dutch gambling regulation and responsible gaming standards

  • Energetic and proactive: you spot opportunities in the data and act on them without waiting to be asked

  • Results-oriented: you focus on commercial outcomes and follow up on the impact of every launch and promotion

  • Solution-oriented: when priorities clash or something breaks, you find a way forward instead of just flagging the problem

  • Decisive: you make day-to-day calls quickly and confidently, keeping things moving in a fast-paced market

NICE TO HAVES

  • Experience with website content management tools

WHO WE ARE


At the core of LeoVegas Group is Team Leo. Our culture is our foundation and is what enables us to innovate, build, and lead as we trailblaze our way through the igaming industry. We’re a team of over 2000 innovators, initiators, and groundbreakers working in a fast-paced and agile environment across 19 offices worldwide.


BENEFITS

  • Hybrid work policy

  • 4 weeks of Workation (T&C apply)

  • 25 vacation days and 3 ATV days

  • Excellent pension scheme

  • 300€/year well-being allowance to support your active lifestyle (T&C apply)

  • Travel and Work-from-home allowance

  • Company provided lunch

  • Team and office social events throughout the year

CALL TO ACTION

In our pride, we empower our teammates to find their roar and run with their wildest ideas. We don’t wait for things to happen; we pounce and make it happen!

Would you be a good fit for the Leo Pride – give us a roar!

data.title: Senior Customer Success Manager
data.description:
Heel werkend Nederland op de fiets! Dat is de krachtige missie van Lease a Bike, waar we ons dagelijks vol passie voor inzetten. Om onze marktleidende positie verder uit te bouwen en nog meer impact te maken, zijn wij op zoek naar een commercieel gedreven Senior Customer Success Manager.

In deze rol krijg jij de verantwoordelijkheid over een portfolio van middelgrote en grote accounts. Je helpt nieuwe klanten succesvol te onboarden en bouwt aan langetermijnrelaties. Een hoge klanttevredenheid en zo veel mogelijk werknemers op de fiets krijgen zijn hierbij jouw belangrijkste doelen. Dit doe je natuurlijk niet alleen: je werkt nauw samen in een gedreven team van 6 collega’s.

Jouw rol als Customer Success Manager

Als Senior Customer Success Manager ben jij de centrale spil tussen jouw klanten en onze interne organisatie. Je schakelt dagelijks met werkgevers en bent intern de verbindende schakel tussen Sales, Product & Innovation, Marketing en Customer Support. In jouw portefeuille richt jij je specifiek op bedrijven met 500+ medewerkers.

Zodra Sales de samenwerkingsovereenkomst heeft getekend, neem jij het stokje over. Je leidt de implementatie en begeleidt de klant gedurende de gehele levenscyclus. Je adviseert werkgevers bij cruciale beleidskeuzes, helpt hen het platform optimaal in te richten en ontwikkelt gerichte activatiecampagnes. Zo zorg je ervoor dat de fietsregeling ook op de lange termijn top-of-mind blijft en de betrokkenheid van werknemers continu hoog is, met als ultiem doel: zoveel mogelijk werknemers op de fiets krijgen!

Daarnaast ben je analytisch ijzersterk. Je gebruikt data om jouw klantsegment grondig te analyseren, ontdekt waar kansen liggen en weet creatieve ideeën om te zetten in concrete acties en resultaat.


Wat vragen we van jou?

  • Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding;

  • Minimaal 3 jaar relevante werkervaring in Customer Success of Accountmanagement;

  • Aantoonbare ervaring met het begeleiden van implementatietrajecten, relatiebeheer en het schrijven van accountplannen;

  • Commercieel ingesteld en communicatief ijzersterk: je doorgrondt klantbehoeften snel en vertaalt deze naar effectieve actieplannen;

  • Een hoge mate van zelfstandigheid en het vermogen om projecten met diverse stakeholders of complexe vraagstukken te leiden;

  • Een sterk probleemoplossend en analytisch vermogen met focus op het uitbouwen van duurzame klantrelaties;

  • Je kunt goed plannen, bewaart het overzicht en gaat gestructureerd te werk;

  • Een flexibele en hands-on mentaliteit die past bij een snelgroeiende marktleider;

  • Uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal in woord en schrift;

Wat bieden wij? 

Naast een uitdagende rol met veel vrijheid, verantwoordelijkheid en een grote impact op de verdere groei van Lease a Bike bieden wij nog veel meer:

  • Een bruto maandsalaris tussen de € 3.950,- en € 4.450. 

  • 8% vakantiegeld, een bonusregeling van 10% én een jaarlijkse winstuitkering;

  • Een jaarlijkse toekenning van 20 wettelijke verlofdagen, 5 bovenwettelijke vakantiedagen en 6 ATV-dagen op basis van een fulltime dienstverband;

  • Een gloednieuwe leasefiets naar keuze (Pon-merk) met een maandelijkse werkgeversbijdrage;

  • Een reiskostenvergoeding of Shuttel-kaart voor de dagen dat je naar kantoor reist;

  • Focus op ontwikkeling: De mogelijkheid om je continu te blijven ontwikkelen via onder andere onze Winter- en Summerlabstrainingen;

  • Een gezonde lunch op kantoor in Amersfoort tegen een kleine bijdrage;

  • Een thuiswerkplek door ons gefaciliteerd met de mogelijkheid voor een netto thuiswerkvergoeding voor als je af en toe thuis wil werken;

  • Een collectieve Zorgverzekering bij ONVZ of Zilveren Kruis met een werkgeversbijdrage;

  • Én, last but not least, een aantrekkelijke pensioenregeling bij het Pon Pensioenfonds van 30% waarbij Lease a Bike 20% bijdraagt.

Over de organisatie

Lease a Bike is ontstaan vanuit liefde voor mensen en fietsen. Voor ons is fietsen niet zomaar een manier van vervoer. Voor ons is fietsen een ‘way of life’. Fietsen is goed voor je gezondheid. Goed voor je portemonnee. Goed voor de wereld. Anderen stimuleren om de fiets te pakken, daar gaan wij voor! Wil jij een bijdrage leveren aan een duurzamere wereld, waarbij vitaliteit en fun hand in hand gaan? Join the ride en draag bij aan de verwezenlijking van onze missie. Als scale-up is Lease a Bike onderdeel van mobiliteitsprovider Bike Mobility Services Group (Pon)!

Overige informatie

Ben je enthousiast over Lease a Bike en over de rol van Senior Customer Success Manager? Solliciteer dan direct via de knop ‘Solliciteren’ en stuur ons je cv en motivatiebrief.

Heb je naar aanleiding van de vacature vragen voor ons? Dan kan je contact opnemen met (HR Adviseur).

data.title: Senior Category Lead Modern Art
Customer Marketing Manager, EMEA
data.description:
Horizon3.ai is seeking a customer-focused, data-driven Customer Marketing Manager to build engagement, adoption, retention, expansion, and advocacy across our EMEA customer base. You will create programs that help customers realize more value from Horizon3, strengthen customer relationships, and turn successful outcomes into credible customer proof.

This role brings together customer lifecycle marketing and customer advocacy. You will develop regional customer communications and campaigns while building a repeatable advocacy engine across customer stories, references, third-party reviews, speakers, and other strategic opportunities. You will work closely with Customer Success, Sales, Product Marketing, Product, and the broader Marketing team to turn customer needs and business priorities into useful, measurable programs.

The ideal candidate is both a strategic planner and a hands-on operator. You can build trust with customers, coordinate complex projects across teams and markets, use data to improve programs, and make it straightforward for customers to participate.

What you will do

Customer lifecycle marketing

  • Plan and execute customer marketing programs across onboarding, activation, adoption, engagement, retention, renewal support, and expansion.

  • Define customer segments, lifecycle stages, journey maps, messaging, and campaign playbooks that can be adapted for EMEA audiences.

  • Partner with Customer Success and Customer Enablement to promote onboarding, education, product engagement, and other programs that help customers achieve meaningful outcomes.

  • Develop proactive re-engagement programs for at-risk or under-engaged accounts using customer health, product usage, support, engagement, and renewal signals.

  • Create signal-based campaigns tied to customer needs, product usage, account changes, renewal timing, and expansion fit. Route qualified opportunities to the appropriate Customer Success Managers and account executives.

  • Partner with Product Marketing and Product to translate customer feedback into product communications, release messaging, educational content, and lifecycle campaigns.

  • Equip Sales and Customer Success with customer-centric messaging, adoption resources, executive business review materials, playbooks, and clear follow-up paths.

Customer advocacy and proof

  • Build and maintain a pipeline of EMEA customer advocates based on customer outcomes, engagement, use cases, and willingness to participate.

  • Partner with Customer Success Managers and account teams to identify customers for case studies, video testimonials, customer quotes, social content, references, and events.

  • Manage customer participation from outreach through briefing, approvals, production, publication, and follow-up. Coordinate logo rights, quotes, and other customer permissions with the appropriate internal teams.

  • Create and manage a practical customer reference program that supports sales opportunities, renewals, expansions, and strategic marketing needs. Maintain an organized reference pool and manage requests from intake and matching through scheduling, follow-up, and recognition.

  • Own day-to-day Peerbound administration and adoption, including customer profiles, advocacy requests, reference activity, permissions, and reporting. Help Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success use the platform consistently and make fuller use of its capabilities.

  • Develop and execute a focused third-party review strategy across relevant platforms, such as G2 and Gartner Peer Insights. Coordinate authentic customer outreach and track review volume, ratings, sentiment, category placement, competitor positioning, and progress against award criteria.

  • Maintain a qualified pipeline of customer speakers for webinars, user groups, events, panels, and other marketing programs. Confirm speakers early enough to include them in event promotions, landing pages, emails, and social campaigns, and manage briefing, preparation, logistics, approvals, and follow-up.

  • Own the customer invitation process for Customer Advisory Board opportunities and support customer recruitment for analyst interviews, research, awards, and other strategic initiatives.

  • Work with Content, Product Marketing, Social, Events, Communications, Analyst Relations, and Creative to elevate customers alongside the Horizon3.ai brand and turn customer outcomes into reusable marketing assets.

Program operations and measurement

  • Build annual and quarterly customer marketing plans for EMEA, manage budgets and resources, and lead cross-functional execution.

  • Work with Marketing Operations, Revenue Operations, and Customer Success Operations to improve segmentation, data quality, trigger detection, nurture, automation, attribution, and reporting.

  • Establish dashboards and operating rhythms that connect program engagement to adoption, customer advocacy, renewal health, retention, expansion pipeline, and influenced revenue.

  • Define success measures, analyze results, identify opportunities to improve, and iterate on program strategy, messaging, and execution.

  • Communicate timelines, owners, status, risks, and next steps clearly across teams. Create practical templates, trackers, and workflows that make customer marketing easier to execute and scale.

What you bring

  • 7+ years of marketing experience, including 3+ years in customer marketing, lifecycle marketing, customer advocacy, customer success enablement, or a related discipline.

  • Experience building customer journeys and programs across adoption, engagement, retention, renewal, expansion, or advocacy.

  • A track record of managing customer stories, references, reviews, speakers, or other advocacy programs, ideally alongside lifecycle marketing responsibilities.

  • Strong relationship-building skills and confidence communicating with customers and internal stakeholders.

  • Experience partnering with Customer Success, Sales, Product Marketing, Product, Marketing Operations, and Revenue Operations.

  • Strong project management and follow-through, with the ability to manage multiple programs and deadlines across teams and markets.

  • Analytical and operational skills, including the ability to connect customer behavior and program performance to business outcomes.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills and the judgment to represent customer perspectives accurately and authentically.

  • Familiarity with customer advocacy, reference, review, CRM, or marketing automation platforms. Peerbound experience is a plus.

  • Understanding of B2B SaaS or cybersecurity customer environments is a plus.

  • Ability to work effectively across EMEA markets and time zones. Additional language skills are a plus.

How success is measured

  • Lifecycle program engagement and contribution to customer adoption, retention, renewal health, and expansion.

  • Growth and health of the EMEA customer advocate and reference pool, including references fulfilled and customer participation.

  • Customer proof produced, including case studies, videos, quotes, approved logos, and social or event participation.

  • Customer speakers confirmed in time to support event and webinar promotion.

  • Peerbound adoption, data quality, and program activity.

  • Review volume, ratings, sentiment, and progress against award criteria.

  • Customer experience and internal stakeholder satisfaction.

data.title: Elektromonteur (Senior)
data.description:
Bij PromTeg doen we wat we beloven. Geen gedoe, wel strak werk waar je trots op bent.

Je komt terecht in een hechte organisatie van ongeveer 30 collega's waar de lijnen kort zijn en vertrouwen vanzelfsprekend is. Vanuit Uitgeest en Duiven werken we aan multidisciplinaire projecten, service en onderhoud voor grote opdrachtgevers door heel Nederland.

Hier ben je geen nummer, maar een ervaren vakman die verantwoordelijkheid neemt, collega's verder helpt en een belangrijke rol speelt binnen technische projecten. Je krijgt veel vrijheid in je werk en kunt rekenen op een team dat achter je staat.

Als Elektromonteur (Senior) werk je aan complexe installaties binnen de utiliteit. Je combineert elektrotechnische werkzaamheden met andere technische disciplines en bent een technisch aanspreekpunt voor collega's, projectleiding en klanten op locatie.

Wat wij je bieden

  • 25 vakantiedagen en 13 ADV-dagen bij een fulltime dienstverband

  • Pensioenregeling volgens de cao Metaal & Techniek

  • Ruimte voor opleidingen, trainingen en relevante certificeringen

  • Mogelijkheden om je verder te ontwikkelen binnen elektrotechniek, brandmeldinstallaties, beveiligingsinstallaties, netwerken, CCTV, toegangscontrole en gebouwbeheersystemen

  • Een nette bedrijfsbus

  • Werk op projectlocaties door heel Nederland, waarbij je waar mogelijk rechtstreeks vanuit huis naar het project rijdt

  • Extra voordelen via VDKnaken, waaronder korting via Centraal Beheer en Corporate Benefits

Wat ga je doen?

Je start je dag op een projectlocatie waar verschillende technische disciplines samenkomen. Je stemt af met collega's, begeleidt waar nodig minder ervaren monteurs en zorgt dat werkzaamheden technisch goed worden uitgevoerd.

De ene keer werk je aan een nieuw utiliteitsproject, de andere keer aan een uitbreiding of renovatie van een bestaande installatie. Dankzij jouw ervaring zie je snel wat nodig is en denk je actief mee over slimme technische oplossingen.

Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:

  • Het realiseren, testen en opleveren van elektrotechnische installaties

  • Het aanleggen van bekabeling en aansluiten van componenten en systemen

  • Het uitvoeren van werkzaamheden binnen grote en technisch complexe utiliteitsprojecten

  • Het adviseren van klanten over technische oplossingen op locatie

  • Het fungeren als technisch aanspreekpunt binnen projecten

  • Het begeleiden van minder ervaren collega's en delen van vakkennis

  • Het werken aan brandmeldinstallaties, beveiligingsinstallaties, CCTV, netwerken, toegangscontrole en gebouwbeheersystemen, afhankelijk van het project en jouw expertise

Heb je jouw ervaring opgebouwd binnen elektrotechniek, brandmeldtechniek of beveiligingstechniek? Dan maken we graag kennis met je. Bij PromTeg krijg je de mogelijkheid om je kennis verder te verbreden en mee te bouwen aan multidisciplinaire projecten.

Wat neem je mee

  • Mbo niveau 3 of 4 Elektrotechniek, of vergelijkbare praktijkervaring

  • Ruime ervaring als zelfstandig elektromonteur, monteur elektrotechniek of installatiemonteur binnen de utiliteit

  • Ervaring binnen brandmeldtechniek, beveiligingstechniek, gebouwbeheersystemen, toegangscontrole of een combinatie daarvan

  • Technische kennis om installaties zelfstandig uit te voeren en complexe storingen of vraagstukken op te lossen

  • Ervaring met het begeleiden van collega's of het aansturen van werkzaamheden op locatie

  • Een zelfstandige en proactieve werkhouding

  • Rijbewijs B

Ben jij een Elektromonteur (Senior) die energie krijgt van technische verantwoordelijkheid, complexe utiliteitsprojecten en het begeleiden van collega's? Dan maken we graag kennis met je.

Een uitgebreid cv is niet nodig voor een eerste gesprek. Bel, app of mail gerust met Joyce Jongejan, Recruitment Business Partner van VDK Groep.

📞 06 - 83170369
