data.title: Junior Business Controller (Data specialist)
data.description:
Do you enjoy working with numbers, analysing data and finding out what is really happening behind the figures? As Junior Business Controller at HG, you will support our Controllers and Group Financial Controller with financial analyses, reporting and increasingly data-driven insights.

At HG, you will work in a compact organisation with an international reach. You will get the opportunity to learn from experienced colleagues, take responsibility early and turn financial and business data into insights that help us make better decisions. We value people who are curious, take initiative and have the energy to turn ideas into action.

About the role

As Junior Business Controller, you will support our Controllers and gradually build your own areas of responsibility. The role combines financial activities with a strong focus on data, analysis and improving management information.

You will:

  • support the Business Controllers with financial analyses, reporting and recurring control activities;

  • own and maintain the data model

  • analyse financial and business data and translate it into useful insights;

  • investigate differences, trends and developments and help explain what is happening behind the numbers;

  • build, review and improve data models used for reporting and analysis;

  • use various tools including Excel and Power BI to make information clearer and easier to use;

  • investigate how data flows from source to report and identify opportunities to improve data quality and reporting;

  • help reduce manual work by finding smarter and more reliable ways of working;

  • contribute to improvements in management information and financial processes;

  • translate questions from colleagues into practical analyses and insights.

An important part of the role is conceptual thinking about data. You understand how information should be structured, see connections between different data points and can think about how a data model can be improved to provide better business insights.

Your development in data

Next to your finance responsibilities, you will grow step by step into the data side of the role, coached by our current Data Specialist. You do not need to master these areas from day one: together we will set up a development path in which you learn to:

  • contribute to HG's Business Intelligence and data strategy, making sure data supports our company goals;

  • design and maintain data models (such as star schemas) and database/Lakehouse structures, so that data is accurate, reliable and accessible;

  • integrate data from different sources and systems in a medallion model (Bronze for raw data, Silver for engineering, Gold for consumption);

  • manage the HG Data Dictionary, data repositories and the underlying data architecture;

  • apply data governance and data quality practices, including audit trails, data privacy requirements and best-practice frameworks such as DAMA;

  • map business processes (BPMN 2.0) and translate business requirements into practical data solutions;

  • work with tools such as SQL, Python (pandas), Power Query, Power Automate and Microsoft Fabric, and over time explore AI techniques;

  • document data models and data processes, and monitor data systems for performance and reliability.

This gives you a strong combination of finance and data expertise, which is becoming increasingly valuable in modern Business Control.

Collaboration & positioning

You will be part of the Finance team and work closely with our Business Controllers. This gives you the opportunity to learn from experienced colleagues while contributing your own analytical and data-driven perspective.

Because HG is a relatively compact organisation, you will have direct contact with colleagues across different disciplines. This means you can quickly see how your analyses and improvements are being used in the business. At the same time, you will work within an international organisation, with colleagues and markets across Europe.

The role is based at our head office in Almere.

HG is a compact, fast-growing and international organization where you can directly see the impact of your work. This requires ownership, initiative and a pragmatic, results-oriented mindset. The team culture is open, pragmatic and focused on results, encouraging you to bring ideas forward, challenge constructively and take responsibility. Everything we do is guided by our three core values: Aim High, Be Brave, Be Connected.


What you bring

We are looking for someone who is analytical, energetic and curious. You enjoy getting to the bottom of a question rather than simply producing a report. You want to understand why the numbers look the way they do and how the underlying data can provide better insights.

You bring:

  • willingness to learn

  • around 3–5 years of relevant work experience, for example as a big 4 auditor, Finance Analyst, Data Analyst or Junior Business Controller;

  • solid knowledge of finance and accounting, preferably gained through an education in Accountancy, Finance & Control, Business Information Management, Data Analytics);

  • experience with or a strong interest in Power BI;

  • strong analytical skills;

  • the ability to think conceptually about data, reporting and data models;

  • a curious and proactive approach to solving problems;

  • the confidence to ask questions and challenge existing ways of working;

  • an energetic mindset and the drive to learn and improve;

  • a genuine eagerness to learn and to keep developing yourself, both in finance and in data;

  • fluent English; knowledge of Dutch is desirable.

  • experience with AI tools, such as Copilot.

    Please note that we do not offer visa or work permit sponsorship for this position. You must therefore hold a valid EU work permit

What we offer

This is a role where you can build a strong foundation in modern Business Control while developing further in data and analytics. You will not only work with existing reports and figures, but also have the opportunity to improve how information is structured, analysed and used.

You can expect:

  • a monthly salary between €4.000 and €5.200 (excluding holiday allowance), depending on your experience.

  • an annual on-target bonus of 10% of your gross annual salary; 

  • full-time employment with 30 days of annual leave; 

  • a pension scheme; 

  • a commuting allowance; 

  • a dynamic and ambitious working environment where initiative and ownership are valued;

  • the opportunity to grow towards a broader Business Controller role as your knowledge, experience and responsibilities develop;

  • structured coaching by our Data Specialist to develop your data skills alongside your finance role;

  • a friendly, welcoming team, with a free shared lunch every Monday and monthly social drinks.

We are HG

HG is a leading European brand in specialist cleaning and maintenance products.

We believe a home should be a place where people can live carefree, with confidence in the products they use to care for the spaces and belongings around them. Our products are developed to do exactly what they promise: deliver effective, reliable and specialist cleaning solutions that help consumers solve real household problems.

HG’s mission is to help people enjoy their homes without worrying about what might go wrong. We do this through high-quality products, specialist expertise, clear advice and a relentless focus on performance.

We are dedicated to delivering superiority, innovation, quality and customer satisfaction. With a strong presence across Europe and beyond, we are continuously investing to make an even bigger impact.

HG does what it promises.


Do you have any questions?

Our colleague Ilse de Groot, Corporate Recruiter, will be happy to answer any questions. You can contact her at

Would you like to apply for the junior business controller position at HG? You can apply directly by uploading your CV. We aim to respond within 5 working days.

Acquisition in response to this vacancy is not appreciated.

data.title: HR-Stagiair(e)
data.description:
Als HR‑Stagiair(e) draai je bij ons mee in het HR‑team en krijg je de kans om veel te leren, met een duidelijke focus op Learning & Development. Je werkt mee aan verschillende HR- en L&D‑activiteiten en krijgt daarnaast de ruimte om je stage zelf vorm te geven en te ontdekken welke andere HR‑onderwerpen jou aanspreken. Zo doe je brede praktijkervaring op in een omgeving waar veel gebeurt en waar je actief kunt bijdragen.


Jouw stage:

Je werkt mee in ons team van 10 HR‑professionals met expertise in o.a. onboarding, L&D, verzuim, recruitment, employer branding en HR‑advies. Je krijgt veel vrijheid én goede begeleiding om jezelf te ontwikkelen.

Waar draag je aan bij?

  • Het versterken van vaardigheden en ontwikkeling binnen de organisatie door mee te werken aan L&D‑projecten.

  • Het soepel laten verlopen van soft skills trainingen, door ondersteuning bij voorbereiding, communicatie en coördinatie.

  • De verbetering van HR‑processen door het initiëren en uitvoeren van eigen HR‑projecten (bijvoorbeeld op het gebied van onboarding, recruitment of procesoptimalisatie).

  • Events rondom arbeidsmarktcommunicatie, workshops rond duurzame inzetbaarheid en onboardingsactiviteiten.

  • Een correcte en overzichtelijke HR‑administratie, zoals het opstellen van contracten, brieven en personele mutaties.

  • Continue verbetering binnen HR door actieve deelname aan HR‑overleggen en het meedenken over verbeteringen.

Onze organisatie beweegt snel: er gebeurt veel en geen week is hetzelfde. Dat biedt enorm veel leerkansen, maar vraagt ook dat jij zelf richting geeft aan je stage en je weg vindt in een dynamische omgeving. Je krijgt van ons goede begeleiding, maar het is aan jou om kansen te zien en initiatief te tonen.

Wat breng je mee?

We zoeken een stagiair(e) die:

  • Een hbo‑opleiding HRM volgt (3e of 4e jaar) en stage wil lopen vanaf februari 2027.

  • Beschikbaar is voor 4 of 5 dagen per week.

  • Geïnteresseerd is in Learning & Development.

  • Sterk is in Nederlands en goed overweg kan met Engels.

  • Nauwkeurig werkt, durft te vragen en zelfstandig durft te handelen.

  • Het leuk vindt om in een dynamische omgeving te werken waar veel gebeurt.

Wij bieden:

  • Stageplek per september 2026 voor 32-40 uur per week.

  • Begeleiding van ervaren HR-professionals.

  • Stagevergoeding van € 650,- per maand op basis van 40 uur.

  • Meedoen met ons Be-Fit programma; wekelijks sporten met collega’s.

  • Ook gewoon een superleuke tijd!

Over Benchmark

Benchmark in Almelo maakt onderdeel uit van de multinational Benchmark Electronics Inc., een beursgenoteerde onderneming op het gebied van het vervaardigen van elektronica en het leveren van diensten richting original equipment manufacturers (OEM’s).

Bij Benchmark werk je voor bedrijven die impact maken met hun innovaties. Zo ontwikkelen we nieuwe producten die de veiligheid of gezondheid verbeteren of juist het gemak vergroten. Deze producten worden geleverd vanaf het productontwerp tot en met productie en soms ook rechtstreeks aan de eindgebruiker. Dit gehele proces wordt geheel in Almelo uitgevoerd.

Wereldwijd heeft Benchmark Electronics Inc. momenteel 23 vestigingen. Op onze vestiging in Almelo werken we samen met zo’n 675 collega’s.

Interesse?

Benchmark wil vooruit, samen met jou als HR-Stagiair(e)!

data.title: Junior Data Consultant
data.description:
Onze Missie

LOGEX is koploper in data-analyse in de gezondheidzorg. Wij zetten complexe zorgdata om in heldere inzichten waarmee zorgorganisaties grip krijgen op kosten, betere behandelresultaten realiseren en sturen op waardegedreven zorg. Onze oplossingen worden dagelijks gebruikt door meer dan 80 zorginstellingen, zowel publiek als privaat, en maken het verschil in de gezondheidszorg van morgen.

Jouw impact en verantwoordelijkheden

  • Je communiceert met klanten over hun data-aanlevering en de oplevering van LOGEX modellen. 

  • Je ontwikkelt je in de breedte en biedt ondersteuning aan meerdere teams en klanten als er vragen liggen met betrekking tot de kwaliteit van data.

Het team is verantwoordelijk voor het implementeren en onderhouden van onze oplossingen en benchmarks, die zowel medische specialisten als de planning- en controleteams in ziekenhuizen ondersteunen.   • Je krijgt energie van het verbeteren van  werkprocessen.

Wat wij bieden:

data.title: Android Engineer
data.description:
Who are we?

We're a smart hydration company rebuilding an industry that still runs on sugar water and single-use packaging.
Filtered water, functional flavors, zero bottles. Still, sparkling, cold, and hot. All poured from one tap. We create hydration people want to reach for, starting with the workplace where we help teams thrive.

As an AI-native company, we build at speed. In 2025, Aquablu ranked 2nd in the Deloitte Technology Fast 50 (Netherlands) and 30th in the Sifted 250 (Europe), both rankings of the fastest-growing companies by revenue growth. In 2026 we were named a winner of Maya's Culture 100 Europe Awards as one of the best workplaces to thrive in.

Growing that fast and thriving comes down to our people. Our team is our biggest asset and one that we’re proud of. We’re committed to maintaining our vibrant culture as we continue to grow.

About the role

Aquablu's products run Android in more places than your pocket. Our dispensing systems ship with Android-powered on-device software that hundreds of thousands of people touch every day, and our mobile apps put hydration in users' hands. As our Android Engineer, you work across that whole surface.

Your main arena is on-device: the software running on the hardware itself, where Android meets the physical world. Screens people tap on a machine, software that talks to firmware, updates that roll out to hundreds of deployed systems in the field. Alongside that, you contribute to our mobile development where the products need it. Few Android roles give you this range.

This is a hands-on engineering role in a small, fast team. You own features end to end and deliver them reliably, reaching out to your manager when support is needed to unblock you. You build with AI agents as your default collaborator, you work cross-functionally with hardware, firmware, and product, proactively identifying and reaching out to key players that can help filling any gaps.

This role reports into our Head of Digital Product, and is part of Aquablu’s Software & Intelligence Engineering team.


What You'll Build & Own

  • On-device Android software: Features on the user-facing software running on our dispensing systems — UI, device behaviour, and the integration layer where software meets hardware. You own your features end to end.

  • Fleet-ready releases: Contribute to releases that update reliably across hundreds of deployed devices in the field, where a broken release means a technician visit. The riskiest releases get a second pair of senior eyes — and you learn what makes them safe.

  • Hardware & firmware integration: Work with embedded and firmware engineers to define and implement serial APIs (UART), that expose device state and trigger mechanical actions.

  • Mobile contribution: Support Android development on our consumer app where the roadmap needs it.

data.description:
Everfield: Senior Data Engineer

The Company

Everfield is a platform with a mission in acquiring, building, and operating vertical market and specialist software companies, focused on European businesses. We invest in and provide support and best practices to software companies in order for them to live up to their full potential by offering a very established approach to promote growth.

Everfield is looking to be the leader in European Vertical and specialist software solutions across myriad niche industries who provide mission-critical applications, service, and support to their clients.

Everfield seeks to deliver innovation and growth to its acquired companies by providing best practices and operational support to help identify opportunities and install proven methodologies to accelerate customer and market share. Everfield is located throughout Europe, with offices in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, France, Poland, Spain, and Latvia.

The Position

As a Senior Data Engineer at Everfield, you will leverage your expertise and experience to:

  • Continuously improve scalability and stability of our data platform called the Lakehouse

  • Create new data pipeline solutions on various data sources (ERP, CRMs, etc.)

  • Design and model data in a common data model and Kimball-style dimensional models, making it ready for consumption in Power BI and other tools

  • Further developing Lakehouse Lumen, our MCP server that makes Lakehouse data available to Claude for end users

  • Improve existing solutions to improve value add for various stakeholders

You’ll be working as part of the Business Intelligence (BI) team. Currently the team consists of a Lead Data Engineer, three Data Analysts and a hands-on team lead. The BI team creates value for various stakeholders (CEO, Finance, COO, Sales, Marketing, and Everfield’sportfolio companies), by creating insights, delivering analysis, automating reporting processes and improving data quality.

The team builds pipelines with Azure Databricks and Azure Synapse Analytics to ingest the data into our data platform, uses Azure Databricks for data transformation, Power BI for data visualization and Azure Container Apps to expose data via a MCP server to Claude. For most solutions, the team uses Python and SQL.

For many use cases we work in an agentic way, using Claude to plan and implement them. To support this, we built the "Lakehouse DevKit". A set of agents and skills that we plan to keep extending and improving.

This role is hybrid from Amsterdam area.

Responsibilities

Adhere to the DevOps methodology by:

  • Collaborate with the Lead Data Engineer and Team Lead to plan and prioritize tasks.

  • Develop data pipelines in Azure Databricks and Azure Synapse Analytics, along with data ingestion and process scripts using PySpark and Pandas, while managing version control through Git.

  • Improve and extend the MCP server that provides data to Claude.

  • Create unit tests, test your own work and review work of colleagues (via Pull Requests), to ensure quality control.

  • Extend the Lakehouse DevKit to support and accelerate agentic development workflows.

  • Enhance and maintain deployment pipelines to facilitate smooth releases to end users.

  • Monitor the data platform (including data pipelines, ingestion/processing jobs, and alerts), while continuously improving logging and monitoring practices.

Ideal Candidate Profile

Hard Skills

Required:

  • 3+ year of experience as Data Engineer, and 5+ years of professional experience within Data or related fields.

  • Expert in PySpark and Pandas for data processing.

  • Experience with Databricks for advanced analytics.

  • Strong knowledge of SQL and data modeling (especially star schema).

  • Familiarity with financial systems (ERP, NetSuite, SAP) and/or experience with CRM systems and customer data.

Nice to have:

  • Experience with Claude Code (agents, skills)

Soft Skills

data.description:
Bij TAGGRS maken we Server-side Tracking toegankelijk voor iedereen. Ruim 20.000 gebruikers vertrouwen op ons platform. Toch kennen nog lang niet alle marketeers TAGGRS, en daar ga jij verandering in brengen.

Social media is een belangrijk onderdeel van onze strategie. LinkedIn staat vol met AI-content en algemene tips. Daarom kiezen wij voor de verhalen van onze mensen, klanten en partners. Zo laten we zien wie we zijn en bouwen we aan vertrouwen. Als Content Marketeer neem jij de lead om TAGGRS naar het volgende niveau te brengen op de socials.

Taken

  • Je bent eigenaar van de contentflow voor onze social kanalen, van idee tot livegang, met LinkedIn als belangrijkste kanaal

  • Je haalt verhalen op bij collega's, klanten en partners en maakt daar inspirerende posts van

  • Je helpt collega's met hun eigen LinkedIn-posts, in hun eigen tone of voice

  • Je beheert de content kalender en zorgt ervoor dat we op koers blijven

  • Je analyseert welke content zichtbaarheid en leads oplevert en stuurt daarop bij

  • Je ontwikkelt en experimenteert met nieuwe creatieve content ideeën

Vereisten

  • Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding, bijvoorbeeld in marketing of communicatie

  • Je schrijft sterk en weet in een paar zinnen de aandacht te trekken

  • Je bent vertrouwd met verschillende social kanalen en weet wat presteert

  • Je verzamelt goede verhalen en voelt aan wat echt is

  • Je neemt eigenaarschap en creëert eigen kansen

  • Je bent nieuwsgierig en wilt een technisch product echt begrijpen

  • Je zet AI slim in, maar weet ook wanneer je het beter niet kunt gebruiken

  • Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands en bent minimaal twee dagen per week op kantoor in Heerenveen

  • Kennis van Engels of Duits is een pré

Benefits

  • Een uitdagende functie binnen een snelgroeiende scale-up, met directe invloed op onze groei

  • Een salaris tussen € 2800 en € 3300

  • Ruimte voor ontwikkeling en trainingen

  • Hybride werken

  • Een (semi-)fulltime contract van 32 tot 40 uur

  • Veel vrijheid om vanaf dag één nieuwe ideeën te testen

Secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden

  • Reiskostenvergoeding van €0,25 per km of volledige OV-vergoeding

  • 24 vakantiedagen, waarvan je er 20 zelf in zet

  • Gezellige teamuitjes en borrels

  • Een tof merchandise pakket

Onze cultuur

Bij TAGGRS werken we vanuit onze TAGGR-kernwaarden. Jij bent:

  • Teamplayer: je werkt graag samen en helpt anderen verder

  • Adaptive: je schakelt makkelijk als prioriteiten veranderen

  • Grounded: je blijft nuchter en gefocust op het doel, ook onder druk

  • Growth minded: je wilt jezelf, het team en onze content steeds beter maken

  • Resilient: je blijft rustig bij tegenslag en zoekt de beste oplossing

Enthousiast over deze functie?

Wil jij TAGGRS zichtbaar maken en een sleutelrol spelen in onze verdere groei? Solliciteer dan vandaag nog! Stuur gerust ook een paar posts of video's mee die je hebt gemaakt. Vragen? Bel of app Natascha via 06-34596629.

Senior AI Solution Specialist
data.description:
Do you want to help an entire organisation turn AI opportunities into solutions that deliver real business value, while still being the person who gets hands-on and builds those solutions?

As Senior AI Solution Specialist at Sunweb Group, you take the lead on our more complex AI initiatives. You turn ambiguous business challenges into working prototypes and scalable solutions, while actively building, configuring and testing those solutions yourself.

You’ll join our five-person Architecture team and work closely with the AI PMO, connecting business teams with architecture, product, engineering, data and security.

This is a hands-on senior technical role, not a purely strategic, architectural or people-management position. Seniority here means tackling more complex challenges, having greater autonomy and impact, and helping others grow. We’re looking for someone who has recent practical experience building technical solutions and wants to continue doing so. You’ll design, prototype, configure, integrate and build, while also providing technical direction when needed.

Location: Rotterdam (Hybrid – 50% in office)
Start Date: January/February 2027

Availability: Fulltime

Your impact

  • Lead complex AI discovery
    Turn unclear, cross-functional or strategically important business challenges into concrete AI opportunities. Take them from problem definition and validation through to a working prototype.

  • Build AI solutions yourself
    Design, develop, configure and test agents, assistants and automated workflows that connect different departments, data sources and systems. You won’t only define what should be built or hand it over to others. You’ll be actively involved in building it.

  • Shape enterprise AI initiatives
    Identify when an AI solution needs to move beyond experimentation into a business-critical or customer-facing product, and work with product and engineering teams to make that transition successful.

  • Design for production
    Define solution architecture, integrations and non-functional requirements, while considering scalability, security, supportability, cost and business value.

  • Create reusable AI patterns
    Develop approaches for grounding, identity, integration, monitoring and evaluation that can be reused across teams, and identify opportunities for shared AI capabilities.

  • Coach and challenge others
    Review solutions, share technical expertise and coach colleagues and business users. You’ll work closely with our AI Solution Specialist and help raise the quality of AI solutions across Sunweb Group, while remaining an active builder yourself.

  • Strengthen responsible AI
    Contribute to our AI framework and guardrails, promote responsible use of AI and help create visibility around our AI initiatives.

Who you are

You’re curious, pragmatic and comfortable navigating ambiguity. You combine strong technical judgement with the ability to communicate complex ideas clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

You know the difference between an impressive AI demo and a solution that creates measurable business value. You enjoy working independently, bringing different perspectives together and sharing what you learn along the way.

Most importantly, you’re a builder. You enjoy getting hands-on with technology, experimenting, developing prototypes and turning ideas into working solutions. You may have led technical initiatives, defined architecture or coached others, but you haven’t moved away from building things yourself, and you don’t want to.

What you bring

Must-haves

  • A proven track record of delivering complex AI, automation, integration, data or cloud solutions

  • Strong solution design skills across applications, APIs, identity, data, integrations and cloud services

  • Experience taking ambiguous business problems from discovery through prototyping, testing and solution design

  • Experience defining architecture options, non-functional requirements and production readiness

  • The ability to translate between business needs and technical possibilities

  • Confidence working with business leaders, architects, product owners and engineers

  • Strong technical leadership skills, with the ability to review, challenge and coach others without stepping away from hands-on delivery

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience with RAG, embeddings, vector search and enterprise knowledge solutions

  • Experience with REST APIs, JSON, webhooks, OAuth, connectors and/or MCP

  • Development or scripting experience with Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, C# or PowerShell

  • Experience working with AI agents, assistants or orchestration workflows

  • Experience in the travel or tourism industry

Our technology

Our AI and technology landscape includes Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, Power Platform, Power Automate, Teams, SharePoint, Microsoft Graph, Azure AI services, Microsoft Foundry, ChatGPT/OpenAI, Claude/Anthropic, MCP, Entra ID and Git.

Let us introduce Sunweb Group  

Sunweb Group is one of Europe’s largest online travel agencies, sending over 1.3 million holidaymakers annually to unforgettable destinations. Operating in eight international markets, we cater to all travelers through our brands, Sunweb and ‘Eliza Was Here.’ With a team of 600 colleagues and operational hubs in Rotterdam, Girona, Paris, Copenhagen, Stockholm, Antwerp, Chambéry, and Zurich, we deliver seamless, high-quality holiday experiences at competitive prices. Our Fast Forward culture fosters focus and trust, enabling us to shape the future of holidays while helping our customers press pause and create lasting memories.   

Why join our journey?

  • Monthly gross salary between €6500,- and €8000,- plus 6 ATV days (based on full-time employment, excluding 8% holiday allowance). Please note: ATV days do not apply to part-time contracts.

  • Enjoy up to 20% off when booking with our brands for you, your family, and your friends.  

  • As an international company we support a hybrid way of working. We provide you with office furniture and IT equipment. 

  • We enjoy the journey so enjoy 25 holidays based on fulltime employment. 

  • Access to LinkedIn Learning and a personalized Reflect & Develop Plan to support your career growth.  

  • Benefit from coaching sessions designed to support your well-being.  

  • Receive work-from-home and travel allowances to ease your daily routine.  

Ready for departure? 

Do you want to become part of our team as Senior AI Solution Specialist? Click on “Apply”. Do you have any questions? Please feel free to reach out to our Talent Acquisition team via . We are looking forward to hearing from you!

Closing date for applications: 5 December

Sunweb Group is an equal opportunity employer, which means we do not discriminate in any way. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive and safe environment for all employees.  

As part of our recruitment process, we use AI-supported tools to assist recruiters in matching candidates to job requirements. Final hiring decisions are always made by human recruiters.

data.title: Hbo/Bachelor Technische Bedrijfskunde / Logistiek Stage
data.description:
Bufab Flos in Eindhoven is specialist in het leveren van bevestigingsmaterialen, technische componenten en logistieke diensten. Wij zijn een gewaardeerde partner voor een breed scala aan klanten op zowel technisch als logistiek gebied. Wij bieden onze klanten advies over technische vraagstukken, of het nu gaat om componenten, A-merk bevestigingsmaterialen, staal, roestvrij staal, gestandaardiseerde onderdelen, assemblages of bewerkte onderdelen volgens de specificaties van de klant. Bufab Flos is een partner die meerwaarde biedt door kosten efficiënte totaalservice. Onze diensten omvatten sourcing, inkoop, kwaliteitsbewaking, opslag, logistiek en levering. Wij werken volgens één eenvoudig principe: afgesproken is afgesproken. In al onze activiteiten streven we ernaar onze klanten te ontzorgen door meerwaarde te bieden op het gebied van techniek, kwaliteit, assemblage en logistiek.

Als HBO Technische Bedrijfskunde / logistiek student krijg je de unieke kans om je theoretische kennis om te zetten in praktijkervaring binnen een dynamische technische omgeving. Je kan onder andere betrokken worden bij:

  • Het analyseren en optimaliseren van bedrijfsprocessen binnen de supply chain, magazijn en Assemblage;

  • Het ondersteunen van verbeterprojecten gericht op efficiëntie, kostenreductie en kwaliteitsverbetering;

  • Het helpen bij de implementatie van technische oplossingen en procesverbeteringen;

  • Het uitvoeren van marktonderzoek en het verzamelen van data voor strategische beslissingen;

  • Het bijdragen aan diverse operationele projecten die zowel technische als bedrijfskundige aspecten omvatten.

Referentienummer: I25-01

Klinkt dit als de uitdaging die jij zoekt? Solliciteer dan vandaag!

——

Bufab Flos in Eindhoven is a specialist in supplying fasteners, technical components and logistics services. We are a valued partner for a wide range of customers in both technical and logistics fields. We offer our customers advice on technical issues, whether it concerns components, A-brand fasteners, steel, stainless steel, standardized parts, assemblies or machined parts according to customer specifications. Bufab Flos is a partner that offers added value through cost-efficient total service. Our services include sourcing, purchasing, quality assurance, warehousing, logistics and delivery. We work according to one simple principle: an agreement is an agreement. In all our activities we strive to unburden our customers by offering added value in the areas of technology, quality, assembly and logistics.

As a HBO Industrial Engineering / Logistics student you have the unique opportunity to convert your theoretical knowledge into practical experience within a dynamic technical environment. You can be involved in, among other things:

  • Analyzing and optimizing business processes within the supply chain, warehouse and assembly;

  • Supporting improvement projects aimed at efficiency, cost reduction and quality improvement;

  • Assisting in the implementation of technical solutions and process improvements;

  • Conducting market research and collecting data for strategic decisions;

  • Contributing to various operational projects that include both technical and business aspects.

Reference number: I25-01

Does this sound like the challenge you are looking for? Please apply today!


Wat zoeken wij?

  • Je volgt een HBO opleiding in Technische Bedrijfskunde of logistiek;

  • Je hebt affiniteit met techniek, processen en bedrijfsvoering;

  • Je bent analytisch, gestructureerd en resultaatgericht;

  • Je hebt goede communicatieve vaardigheden en kunt goed samenwerken in een team;

  • Je bent leergierig, proactief en hebt een hands-on mentaliteit.

——

What are we looking for?

  • You are following an HBO course in Industrial Engineering or Logistics;

  • You have an affinity with technology, processes and business operations;

  • You are analytical, structured and results-oriented;

  • You have good communication skills and can work well in a team;

  • You are eager to learn, proactive and have a hands-on mentality.

data.title: Software Engineer (Python & Cloud)
data.description:
Build the software behind large-scale battery storage

Solar and wind power are not always available when we need electricity. Large-scale battery storage helps by storing electricity when supply is abundant and releasing it when demand rises. This keeps the grid flexible and reduces reliance on fossil fuels.

But how do you connect a battery site of hundreds of megawatts to a central IT platform? And how do you build software that is ready for the projects still to come? As a Software Engineer at GIGA Storage, these are the challenges you will work on.

About GIGA Storage

Founded in 2018, we are an international scale-up growing across the Netherlands, Belgium and Germany. Our purpose, ‘Unlock every Green Watt’, is about making the energy system better and more affordable for future generations. We aim to have 1.5 to 2 GW of battery power operational by 2030. At 2 GW, that is theoretically enough peak power to supply more than a million homes simultaneously.

We pioneer at a scale where many solutions are still being developed. We take ownership, share knowledge and make decisions together. Rapid growth also calls for adaptability: priorities shift and not everything is defined in advance.

Your role

You develop and grow our Giga platform. You build software in Python, working with technologies including SQL, Terraform, Grafana and data processing. You do not need to know everything already: you enjoy learning beyond your own specialism.

What will you work on? When a new battery site goes live, data on capacity, performance and equipment status needs to flow reliably into our platform. You build the software and integrations that make this happen. At the same time, you strengthen the foundations: fewer manual steps, better-documented code and reusable solutions for future sites. We work by the principle ‘you build it, you run it’. You can propose tools and improvements; important technical decisions are made together with the team and our IT Lead.

What will you do?

  • Build software. Develop and maintain Python services and integrations for new battery sites.

  • Make data reliable. Build and improve data pipelines, quality checks and monitoring.

  • Work smarter. Automate repeatable tasks and improve documentation, standards and maintainability, using AI tools where useful.

  • Own what you build. Test, deploy and support your software, and discuss technical improvements with the team.

  • Add knowledge, creativity and fun to the IT team.

What do you bring?

  • Higher professional education (HBO) level of thinking and working, and at least four years of relevant software development experience.

  • Python experience; one year may be sufficient if you have also programmed in other languages.

  • Experience with at least one cloud platform: GCP, AWS or Azure.

  • Interest in data engineering and DevOps; Terraform, SQL and CI/CD knowledge is a plus.

  • A broad technical mindset, ownership and a willingness to automate, document and share knowledge.

  • Good English communication skills and availability to work from our Amsterdam office at least three days a week.

Energy-sector experience and Dutch language skills are not required.

Why join GIGA Storage?

  • Visible impact. Your software helps bring new battery sites into operation.

  • Technical variety. Combine software, data and cloud while broadening your skills.

  • Room to contribute. Help automate our platform and prepare it for the next stage of growth.

  • Build together. Join five international IT colleagues in our new Buitenveldert office, close to Amsterdam Zuid.

What do we offer?

  • A competitive salary plus holiday allowance (8%)

  • A fixed year-end bonus (7-9%) and performance-related bonus (max 10%).

  • 28 days of annual leave for full-time employment

  • A pension plan.

  • A €750 annual learning budget, laptop, phone allowance and e-bike scheme.

  • Hybrid working: at least three days a week in our Amsterdam office; choose home or office for the remaining days.

  • Healthy lunches and occasional fun activities

Ready to build with us?

Want to develop software that matters while working on the energy transition? Apply through our website. We look forward to meeting you!

data.title: Account Executive - Enterprise
data.description:
This is an opportunity for an experienced enterprise seller to join an Enterprise Sales Team that's already winning record-breaking deals, with a huge addressable market still to capture.

Vesper is seven years old, with strong product-market fit and a team of hard-working, ambitious people taking it to the next level! In this role and territory, you'll come up against just one competitor: one we're currently outpacing on technical development and new business.

This is not your typical AE role. You'll be joining a high-performing commercial organization with real ownership, real impact, and uncapped potential to hit your goals. It's a role for an ambitious closer looking for a high-growth company that's redefining the global food industry.

Why you should join us

  • Own Your Success: You have complete control over the sales cycle. No silos, no hand-holding; just real responsibility and the opportunity to make a massive impact.

  • Work With Customers Around the World: Start your morning with prospects in Asia, connect with European decision-makers by midday, and close deals in the Americas in the afternoon. You'll gain exposure to international markets and sharpen your skills across cultures.

  • Hone Your Sales Mastery: You'll be selling to procurement managers, some of the toughest negotiators out there. This isn't just another sales job; it's an elite training ground for top-tier closers.

  • Supported by a Top Marketing & BDR Team: Our demand gen engine is strong. You'll work alongside a highly effective marketing team and a dedicated BDR team that books you qualified meetings with ICP accounts. Cold calling works in our business.

  • We Invest in Your Growth: We regularly bring in trainers, run the internal Vesper Academy, and provide coaching to sharpen your pitch, negotiation, and closing techniques.

What you will bring

  • Industry Knowledge: You've worked in the Market Intelligence industry before and understand the value we deliver to our clients.

  • Full-Cycle Sales: You'll own the end-to-end sales process: running high-impact discovery calls and demos, demonstrating value through proofs of concept, and converting prospects into paying customers. Our sales methodology is called Value-Based Selling.

  • Strategic Targeting: You'll work closely with BDRs to refine messaging, target high-value accounts (€1bn+ revenue), and optimize our approach to maximize conversions.

  • Closing Deals: You'll multi- and single-thread accounts, design the right subscription packages, navigate complex negotiations, and secure high-value contracts with key decision-makers (VP and C-level).

  • Growing Our Market Share: You'll have the freedom to work across our Ideal Customer Profile, targeting FMCG, retail, and food companies worldwide.

What you get

  • A fun, young, and innovative atmosphere

  • An entrepreneurial environment where you learn something new every day

  • Personal responsibility with plenty of autonomy and room to grow

  • The chance to see your work make a real difference — helping transform a traditional industry that touches everyday life

  • A fantastic location in the heart of Amsterdam

  • Great hangouts with brilliant people

  • Some additional cool perks — see below!
